items.title: 〈美股早盤〉美伊緊張局勢降溫、油價跌破80美元 主要指數開高
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Higher as U.S.-Iran Tensions Ease and Oil Falls Below $80
paras: 美股主要指數周一 (3 日) 開高，美國總統川普取消原定對伊朗發動的攻擊，中東緊張局勢出現降溫希望，帶動國際油價重挫、西德州原油跌破每桶 80 美元，緩解市場對能源價格推升通膨的擔憂。
風險偏好回升，加上企業財報表現穩健，道瓊指數早盤一度大漲逾 600 點，美國公債同步走高、殖利率下滑。投資人本周也將迎來密集的企業財報與重要經濟數據。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近 600 點或 1.1%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近 220 點或 近 0.9%，標普 500 指數漲 0.7%，費城半導體指數跌 2.9%。台積電 ADR 跌近 0.8%。
美伊緊張局勢出現降溫跡象，國際油價周一一度暴跌逾 7%，緩解市場對能源成本推升通膨、迫使利率長期維持高檔的擔憂，帶動美股期指與美國公債同步上漲。
標普 500 指數期貨上漲 0.5%，為本周美股開出紅盤增添希望。美國總統川普取消原定對伊朗發動的軍事攻擊後，布蘭特原油期貨一度重挫 7.3%，跌至每桶 81.55 美元。
美債殖利率全面下降，指標 10 年期美債殖利率下滑 6 個基點至 4.68%，脫離今年 1 月以來最高水準。彭博美元指數則下跌 0.1%。
IG 駐巴黎首席市場分析師 Alexandre Baradez 表示，地緣政治消息帶動油價下降，也減輕債券殖利率的上行壓力。不過，美債殖利率、金融槓桿與聯準會 (Fed) 政策仍存在問題，在這些不確定性消除前，還不能斷言股市已完全擺脫風險。

荷姆茲海峽協商傳進展 市場等待和平協議

伊朗周一透露，讓船舶恢復通行荷姆茲海峽的談判正取得進展。川普先前也表示，在取消攻擊伊朗後，美伊兩國將恢復協商。
美伊戰爭引發的供應緊縮已推高燃料成本，加深市場對新一波通膨的擔憂。AT Global Markets 首席市場分析師 Nick Twidale 表示，如果美伊達成具體和平協議，或更重要的是荷姆茲海峽重新開放，全球市場可能出現強勁的紓壓反彈。
不過，《彭博》策略師警告，原油市場仍不能將美伊衝突拋在腦後，價格風險依舊偏向上行。選擇權市場對油價上漲的擔憂仍高於下跌，顯示交易員認為供應衝擊再次推高布蘭特原油的可能性，仍大於油價持續大幅下滑。
除中東局勢外，AI 類股估值與通膨風險仍主導市場走勢。投資人本周將密切關注周五公布的美國 7 月就業報告，藉此研判 Fed 下一步政策。SpaceX 則將於周二公布上市後首份財報，歐洲企業匯豐與諾和諾德也將發布業績。
個股方面，百時美施貴寶盤前大漲逾 8%，消息傳出英國製藥大廠阿斯特捷利康曾研究收購這家公司；阿斯特捷利康在倫敦重挫逾 7%。萬豪國際因獲利展望不佳下跌 3.7%。
歐洲道瓊 600 指數上漲 0.4%，消費品與汽車類股領漲。亞洲股市則普遍走低，南韓晶片股大跌，顯示 AI 概念股的劇烈震盪尚未結束。

日元劇烈震盪 美日不排除再次聯手干預

日元周一早盤先跌後升，兌美元一度大漲 1.4%，隨後吐回大部分漲幅，倫敦盤交易於 156.90 附近。市場猜測，美日上周協調干預後，官方可能再次進場買進日元，但部分波動也可能來自緊張的交易員或演算法交易。
日本財務省證實，美日已於美國時間 7 月 31 日協調進行買進日元的操作，若有必要，不會猶豫再次聯手干預。美國財長貝森特表示，美方出手是為了遏止日元「失序」波動，未來也準備繼續協助日本，並提到日本可使用 Fed 的一項融通機制。
野村國際北亞投資長 Julia Wang 預期，未來一周日元可能繼續震盪，並出現暫時性走強；但干預措施並未改變美元兌日元的實際方向，一旦官方操作結束，美元兌日元仍可能重新走高。

華爾街分析：

摩根士丹利將韓股評等由「中立」上調至「優於大盤」，認為近期槓桿部位大幅退場，已為投資人重新布局人工智慧 (AI) 與工業超級循環題材提供更好的進場點。該行指出，韓國綜合股價指數 (KOSPI) 距離 9000 點目標仍有約 36% 上漲空間，近期跌勢主要由技術性因素造成，槓桿型 ETF、避險基金及散戶融資部位的去槓桿進程已經過半。KOSPI 自 6 月高點以來累計下跌逾 30%。

paras_en: U.S. equity indexes opened higher on Monday (the 3rd) as President Trump cancelled the planned attack on Iran, raising hopes that Middle‑East tensions are cooling. The news sent international oil prices plunging, with West Texas Intermediate falling below $80 a barrel, easing market worries that energy costs could fuel inflation.

Risk appetite rebounded and corporate earnings were solid, sending the Dow Jones Industrial Average up more than 600 points in early trade, while U.S. Treasury yields fell. Investors this week also face a packed schedule of corporate earnings and key economic data.

Just before the deadline, the Dow was up about 600 points or 1.1%, the Nasdaq Composite rose roughly 220 points or about 0.9%, the S&P 500 gained 0.7%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index slipped 2.9%. Taiwan Semiconductor ADR fell about 0.8%.

Signs of a de‑escalation in U.S.–Iran tensions saw oil prices plunge more than 7% on Monday, easing concerns that energy costs would push inflation higher and force rates to stay elevated, which in turn lifted U.S. futures and Treasury bonds.

S&P 500 futures rose 0.5%, adding optimism to a week of mostly red sessions for U.S. stocks. After Trump scrapped the planned military strike on Iran, Brent crude futures tumbled 7.3% to $81.55 a barrel.
U.S. Treasury yields fell across the board, with the benchmark 10‑year yield down six basis points to 4.68%, slipping from its peak since January. Bloomberg’s dollar index slipped 0.1%.

IG’s chief market analyst in Paris, Alexandre Baradez, said geopolitical news drove oil lower and also eased upward pressure on bond yields. However, he warned that Treasury yields, financial leverage and Fed policy still pose risks, and until those uncertainties are cleared the market cannot claim to be out of danger.

Progress reported in Houthi‑controlled Strait of Hormuz talks and markets await a peace deal. Iran said on Monday that negotiations to reopen the strait were making headway, and Trump had earlier said that after canceling the attack, the U.S. and Iran would resume talks.

The war‑driven supply squeeze had lifted fuel costs and deepened worries about a new wave of inflation. AT Global Markets’ chief analyst Nick Twidale said that a concrete peace agreement—or, more importantly, the reopening of the strait—could spark a strong relief rally in global markets.

But Bloomberg strategists cautioned that the oil market cannot ignore the U.S.–Iran conflict, and price risk remains skewed higher. Options markets show more concern about oil rising than falling, indicating traders still see a higher chance of supply shocks pushing Brent up again rather than a sustained sharp decline.

Beyond the Middle East, AI‑related stock valuations and inflation risk continue to dominate market direction. Investors will watch Friday’s U.S. July jobs report closely to gauge the Fed’s next move. SpaceX will release its first post‑IPO earnings on Tuesday, and European firms HSBC and Novo Nordisk are also slated to report.

On the equity side, Bristol‑Myers Squibb jumped more than 8% pre‑market after rumors that UK drugmaker AstraZeneca had explored a takeover; AstraZeneca fell more than 7% in London. Marriott International slid 3.7% after a weak profit outlook.
Europe’s DAX 600 rose 0.4%, led by consumer and auto stocks. Asian markets were broadly lower, with South Korean chip stocks tumbling, showing that the AI‑stock volatility has not yet subsided.

The yen swung sharply on Monday, first falling then rising, spiking 1.4% against the dollar before giving back most of the gain and trading near 156.90 in the London session. Markets speculate that after coordinated intervention last week, officials may step in again, though some of the movement may stem from nervous traders or algorithmic activity.

Japan’s finance ministry confirmed that Japan and the U.S. coordinated a yen‑buying operation on July 31 (U.S. time) and would not hesitate to intervene again if needed. U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen said the action was meant to curb “disorderly” yen moves and that the U.S. stands ready to continue assisting Japan, noting Japan could tap a Fed liquidity facility.

Nomura International’s North Asia head Julia Wang expects the yen to remain volatile and possibly see a temporary bounce this week, but she says intervention has not changed the underlying dollar‑yen trend; once official action ends, the dollar could resume its rise against the yen.

As of about 21:00 Taipei time on Monday (the 3rd): Dow Jones Industrial Average up 659.95 points or 1.26% at 53,144.98; Nasdaq Composite up 95.23 points or 0.38% at 25,469.09; S&P 500 up 41.14 points or 0.55% at 7,530.86; Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 375.12 points or 3.32% at 10,935.95; Taiwan Semiconductor ADR down 1.29% to $399.08; 10‑year Treasury yield down to 4.68%; NY light crude down 6.37% to $79.28 a barrel; Brent crude down 4.94% to $83.59 a barrel; gold down 0.45% to $4,088.60 an ounce; dollar index down to 99.79.

Key stocks: AstraZeneca (AZN‑US) fell 7.62% in early trade to $156.72. The Financial Times reported AstraZeneca and Bristol‑Myers Squibb (BMY‑US) are discussing a merger, causing divergent moves – AstraZeneca down more than 4% pre‑market, Bristol‑Myers up over 5%. Alibaba (BABA‑US) rose 4.60% to $127.87 after unveiling its new AI model Qwen 3.8‑Max, one of its most powerful to date, slated for release next week. Micron (MU‑US) fell 3.79% to $791.82; memory stocks were broadly lower after last week’s volatility, with SanDisk (SNDK‑US) and Micron each down over 3% and Seagate (STX‑US) down 2.5%.
Today's key economic data: U.S. July ISM manufacturing index expected at 54.0 (previous 53.3); U.S. July manufacturing PMI final expected at 53.8 (previous 53.8).

Wall Street analysis: Morgan Stanley upgraded its rating on Korean equities from “neutral” to “outperform,” citing a recent sharp retreat of leveraged positions that creates a better entry point for AI and industrial super‑cycle themes. The firm sees the KOSPI still having about 36% upside to a 9,000‑point target, noting the recent decline was largely technical and that de‑leveraging of leveraged ETFs, hedge funds and retail margin has passed the halfway point. The KOSPI has fallen more than 30% since its June peak. Korean stocks, a key gauge of Asian AI demand, have been hit hard by rapid fund outflows, the prevalence of leveraged ETFs and concentration in index weights, amplifying the drop. Morgan Stanley projects the KOSPI could swing between 5,500 and 10,500 points in the short term, with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix providing valuation support; industrial, defense and financial stocks may also benefit from favorable fundamentals.

items.title: 佳必琪擬一年內加碼崧騰最多1成持股 每股價格上限60元
items.title_en: Chin Pao Ki to Increase Stake in Sungtop by up to 10% within a Year at a Price Cap of NT$60 per Share
paras: 連接線廠佳必琪 (6197-TW) 今 (3) 日公告，董事會決議擬自 2026 年 8 月 3 日至 2027 年 8 月 2 日止一年內自集中交易市場取得崧騰 (3484-TW) 不超過 10% 股權，每股價格 60 元內，交易總金額最高 4.23 億元。
佳必琪表示，此次取得股權目的為資產配置，增進資金運用效益，目前佳必琪持有崧騰 3381 張、約 4.289% 持股；旗下佳士麒投資則持有 1349 張、約 1.711% 持股；合計對崧騰持股 4730 張、持股比重 6%。
崧騰主要生產電控零組件產品，並擁有多款連接器、Busbar 產品線，已廣泛應用於電動車、儲能系統與伺服器機櫃等領域。
隨著雲端運算與 AI 應用快速擴展，資料中心對標準化與模組化平台的需求日益提升，OCP 架構成為全球基礎設施建置的重要趨勢，崧騰也持續推動產品與開放運算架構 (OCP, Open Compute Project) 的對接應用。
佳必琪近年積極衝刺 AI 電源布局，包括 ORV3 大電流電源線、Busflow 及 Busbar 等產品，均取得輝達 (NVDA-US) 及 OCP 雙重認證，並切入各大 CSP 與主要 ODM 供應鏈並量產出貨，成為下半年主要成長動能之一。
paras_en: Chin Pao Ki (6197-TW) announced on August 3 that its board of directors has decided to acquire up to a 10% stake in Sungtop (3484-TW) from the concentrated trading market between August 3, 2026, and August 2, 2027, with a price cap of NT$60 per share, and a total transaction amount of up to NT$423 million.

Chin Pao Ki stated that the purpose of this acquisition is for asset allocation and to enhance the efficiency of fund utilization. Currently, Chin Pao Ki holds 3,381 shares of Sungtop, approximately 4.289% of the company's shares, while its subsidiary, Chin Pao Ki Investment, holds 1,349 shares, approximately 1.711% of the company's shares. In total, Chin Pao Ki holds 4,730 shares of Sungtop, representing a 6% stake in the company.

Sungtop primarily produces electrical control component products and has multiple connector and Busbar product lines, which have been widely applied in the fields of electric vehicles, energy storage systems, and server cabinets.

As cloud computing and AI applications continue to expand rapidly, the demand for standardized and modular platforms in data centers is increasing. The OCP (Open Compute Project) architecture has become a major trend in global infrastructure construction, and Sungtop continues to promote the application of its products with OCP.

In recent years, Chin Pao Ki has been actively promoting its AI power layout, including ORV3 high-current power lines, Busflow, and Busbar products, all of which have obtained dual certification from NVIDIA (NVDA-US) and OCP. These products have entered the supply chains of major CSPs and ODMs and have been mass-produced and shipped, becoming one of the main growth drivers in the second half of the year.

items.title: 韓國央行抄底黃金 13年來首次增持！
items.title_en: South Korea's Central Bank Resumes Gold Purchases After 13 Years
paras: 韓國央行時隔逾 13 年重啟黃金購買計畫，並同步布局黃金 ETF，象徵這家長期因政治壓力而迴避黃金的央行正式轉向，加入全球央行增持黃金浪潮。
韓國銀行宣布，將在中長期內提高黃金在外匯儲備中的比重，並引入從國內黃金供應商採購出口用黃金的新渠道。
與此同時，韓國央行還開始購買以黃金為標的的美國交易所交易基金（ETF），但 ETF 在外匯儲備統計中歸類為證券，而非黃金。
此次韓國央行重啟購金，終結了自 2013 年 2 月以來長達 13 年的空窗期。韓國銀行外匯儲備管理部門負責人 Jeong Hee-seop 表示，地緣政治風險上升帶動市場對黃金避險屬性的關注度提高，加之金價已從高檔回落，價格壓力減輕，央行判斷有必要擴大黃金持有量。
韓國銀行目前持有黃金 104.4 噸，在世界黃金協會追蹤的 100 個國家中排名第 40 名。
然而，黃金佔其外匯儲備的比例僅 3.5%，在 100 國中排名第 98 名，與韓國外匯儲備規模全球第 13 名的地位嚴重不符。
韓國銀行此次轉向，契合全球央行加速增持黃金的大背景。在美國金融制裁風險上升的背景下，各國央行正透過擴大黃金儲備降低對美元資產的依賴。
世界黃金協會的數據顯示，2024 年至今年 7 月底，波蘭央行購金量居全球首位，達 255.2 噸，其次為中國（96.1 噸）。
截至上月，全球黃金儲備最多的國家依次為美國（8,134 噸）、德國（3,350 噸）、義大利（2,452 噸）和法國（2,437 噸）；正在削減美債持倉的中國和俄羅斯，分別以 2,332 噸和 2,292 噸位列第五和第六。
世界黃金協會上月發布的一項針對 74 家央行的調查顯示，45%（33 個國家）計劃在一年內增加黃金儲備，60 個國家預估未來五年黃金持有量將持續增長。
paras_en: The Bank of Korea has restarted its gold buying program after a 13-year hiatus, and is also investing in gold ETFs, marking a significant shift for the central bank, which has long avoided gold due to political pressure, and is now joining the global trend of central banks increasing their gold reserves.

The Bank of Korea announced that it will increase the proportion of gold in its foreign exchange reserves over the medium to long term, and will introduce a new channel to purchase gold from domestic suppliers for export purposes.
At the same time, the central bank has begun buying gold ETFs, which are classified as securities rather than gold in foreign exchange reserve statistics.

This move by the Bank of Korea ends a 13-year period of inactivity in gold purchases, which had lasted since February 2013. According to Jeong Hee-seop, head of the bank's foreign exchange reserve management department, the rise in geopolitical risks has increased market attention to gold's safe-haven attributes, and with gold prices having fallen from their highs, the central bank has deemed it necessary to expand its gold holdings.

The Bank of Korea currently holds 104.4 tons of gold, ranking 40th among 100 countries tracked by the World Gold Council. However, the proportion of gold in its foreign exchange reserves is only 3.5%, ranking 98th among the 100 countries, which is severely out of line with its position as the 13th largest foreign exchange reserve holder globally.

The Bank of Korea's shift is in line with the global trend of central banks accelerating their gold purchases. In the face of rising risks of US financial sanctions, central banks are reducing their dependence on dollar assets by increasing their gold reserves.

According to data from the World Gold Council, from 2024 to the end of July this year, the Polish central bank was the largest buyer of gold, with 255.2 tons, followed by China with 96.1 tons. As of last month, the countries with the largest gold reserves were the US (8,134 tons), Germany (3,350 tons), Italy (2,452 tons), and France (2,437 tons), while China and Russia, which are reducing their US bond holdings, ranked fifth and sixth with 2,332 tons and 2,292 tons, respectively.

A survey of 74 central banks by the World Gold Council last month found that 45% (33 countries) plan to increase their gold reserves within the next year, and 60 countries expect their gold holdings to continue to grow over the next five years.

items.title: 處置期縮短 首檔櫃買處置股適用新制將提前至8/10出關
items.title_en: Shortened Disposal Period: First OTC Stock to Benefit from New Regulations to be Released on 8/10
paras: 近期台股因波動劇烈，包括立委及市場高度關注，證交所、櫃買中心今 (3) 日下午分別緊急召開記者會，宣布修改含處置期間長短、撮合頻率等規則，新制於本 (8) 月 10 日起實施。櫃買今日也公告 1 檔處置股旭然 (4556-TW)，因處置期間屬新舊制交替期，原自明 (4) 日起處置至 8 月 17 日，現因新制而可在 8 月 10 日提前解除處置交易。
據證交所、櫃買公告，處置制度於 30 年以來首次變革，處置天數與撮合時間大幅鬆綁。其中，第一、第二次遭列處置的個股，其處置期間原為 10 個營業日，將縮短至 5 日，至於當沖占比較高的個股則為 7 日；撮合也從原定每 5 分鐘或 20 分鐘撮合一次，縮短為每 2 分鐘一次。
因市場新制將於 8 月 10 日上路，期間若仍處於處置期間股票，若於 8 月 10 日前已處置滿 5 日 (或當沖加重者滿 7 日)，則自 8 月 10 日起直接解除處置。
其中因櫃買中心今日公告新增處置股旭然，因最近 6 個交易日累積最後成交價跌幅達 40.8%，而遭列處置股。但因旭然處置期間剛好跨越新舊制交替，原訂舊制自 8 月 4 日起將處置至 8 月 17 日限制，因符合新制處置滿 5 個營業日規定，而提前於 8 月 10 日解除，成為首檔受惠於處置新制的個股。
依照公告，旭然明日處置仍為每 20 分鐘撮合一次，8 月 10 日的處置最終日將縮減為 2 分鐘撮合新制。
paras_en: Recently, the Taiwanese stock market has experienced significant fluctuations, drawing attention from lawmakers and the market. In response, the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the GreTai Securities Market held emergency press conferences on the 3rd, announcing amendments to the disposal period and matching frequency rules, which will take effect on August 10. The GreTai Securities Market also announced that one stock, Hsuan Yuan (4556-TW), will be subject to the new regulations, and its disposal period, originally scheduled from August 4 to August 17, will be shortened to end on August 10.

According to the announcements from the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the GreTai Securities Market, the disposal system has undergone its first major change in 30 years, significantly relaxing the disposal period and matching time. For stocks that are listed for disposal for the first or second time, the disposal period will be shortened from 10 business days to 5 days, while stocks with high intraday trading ratios will have a disposal period of 7 days. The matching frequency will also be increased from every 5 or 20 minutes to every 2 minutes.

As the new regulations will take effect on August 10, stocks that are still under disposal during this period will be directly removed from disposal if they have already been disposed of for 5 days (or 7 days for stocks with high intraday trading ratios) before August 10. Hsuan Yuan, which was announced as a new disposal stock by the GreTai Securities Market today, has seen a cumulative decline of 40.8% in its closing price over the past 6 trading days and has been listed for disposal. However, as its disposal period coincides with the transition between the old and new regulations, it will be released from disposal on August 10, becoming the first stock to benefit from the new disposal regulations.

According to the announcement, Hsuan Yuan's disposal will still be matched every 20 minutes tomorrow, but on August 10, the final day of its disposal, it will be matched every 2 minutes under the new regulations.

items.title: 舊制勞退歡迎「變新」！專家提醒報稅撇步：純舊制自提享3大稅務優惠
items.title_en: Old System Labor Retirement Welcomes "Change"! Experts Remind Taxation Steps: Pure Old System Self-Payment Enjoy 3 Tax Preferences
paras: 勞基法舊制勞工退休金新規上路，今年 7 月 17 日修正生效的勞工退休金條例施行細則，正式允許純舊制勞工每月在 6% 範圍內自願提繳退休金至個人專戶，同時符合條件者也可與雇主合意提前結算舊制退休金並全數移入專戶，享有新制最低收益保障與免計入當年度薪資所得等三大稅務優惠，為退休資產累積提供更多元管道。
勞工退休金條例施行細則 7 月修正生效後，新增規定讓純舊制勞工也能透過自願提繳累積退休資產。KPMG 安侯建業稅務投資部執業會計師陳志愷表示，本次修正核心目的在於讓純舊制勞工也能自提退休金，並透過提前結算舊制並移入個人專戶增加儲蓄與投資收益來源。雇主不得拒絕勞工提出的自提申請，且勞雇雙方合意結算的舊制退休金必須全數移入個人專戶，不得選擇部分或不移入。

在稅務影響方面，陳志愷指出本次修正涉及 3 項重要課稅重點。首先，自提退休金免計入當年度薪資所得，依月提繳工資分級表辦理不計入課稅。其次，提前結算並移入專戶的舊制退休金，因勞工尚未實際領取，移入時不課稅，待未來請領時再依退職所得規定辦理。最後，實際請領退休金時應依退職所得計算稅負，當勞工年滿 60 歲或喪失工作能力符合條件時，無論自提金、結算移入金或累積收益，均應併入退職所得，超過定額免稅標準部分才須課徵所得稅。
陳志愷進一步說明，若勞工於提前結算後持續服務所累積的舊制退休金並未移入專戶，而是在勞動契約終止時另行給付，為避免重複適用免稅額度，應與先前已自專戶請領的退休金合併計算退職所得，再就超過定額免稅標準部分課徵所得稅。陳志愷也提醒，本次修正雖將自提機制擴及純舊制勞工，但並未改變其適用舊制的身分，雇主無須為其提繳新制退休金，仍應依結算後持續工作所累積的舊制年資提撥退休準備金並認列相關費用。
paras_en: The new regulations for labor retirement under the old system have taken effect. The revised "Regulations for the Implementation of Labor Retirement Pension" that came into effect on July 17 this year allow pure old system laborers to voluntarily pay 6% of their retirement pension into their personal accounts every month. Those who meet the conditions can also agree with their employers to settle their old system retirement pension in advance and transfer it to their personal accounts, enjoying three tax benefits, including the minimum guaranteed return under the new system and exemption from inclusion in the current year's salary income, providing more channels for accumulating retirement assets.

After the revision of the "Regulations for the Implementation of Labor Retirement Pension" in July, new regulations allow pure old system laborers to accumulate retirement assets through voluntary payments. Chen Zhi-kai, a certified public accountant at KPMG, stated that the core purpose of this revision is to allow pure old system laborers to pay their retirement pension themselves and increase their savings and investment income through advance settlement of the old system and transfer to personal accounts. Employers cannot refuse laborers' applications for self-payment, and the old system retirement pension settled by both parties must be transferred to the personal account in full and cannot be partially or not transferred.

Regarding tax implications, Chen Zhi-kai pointed out that this revision involves three important tax points. Firstly, self-paid retirement pension is exempt from inclusion in the current year's salary income and is handled according to the monthly payment table without taxation. Secondly, the old system retirement pension that is settled in advance and transferred to a personal account is not taxed at the time of transfer since the laborer has not actually received it, and taxation will be handled according to the regulations for retirement income when it is claimed in the future. Lastly, when the retirement pension is actually claimed, the tax burden should be calculated according to the retirement income regulations. When the laborer is 60 years old or loses their working ability and meets the conditions, regardless of whether it is self-paid, settled, and transferred, or accumulated income, it should be included in the retirement income, and only the part exceeding the standard tax exemption will be subject to income tax.

Chen Zhi-kai further explained that if a laborer's old system retirement pension accumulated after advance settlement is not transferred to a personal account but is paid separately when the labor contract is terminated, to avoid duplicate application of tax exemption, it should be combined with the previously claimed retirement pension from the personal account to calculate the retirement income, and then the part exceeding the standard tax exemption will be subject to income tax. Chen Zhi-kai also reminded that although this revision has expanded the self-payment mechanism to pure old system laborers, it does not change their status under the old system, and employers do not need to pay new system retirement pension for them. They should still pay the retirement preparation fund according to the accumulated old system seniority after settlement and recognize the related expenses.

items.title: 「巴菲特指標」衝破230%狂閃紅燈 美股真的要崩盤了嗎？
items.title_en: The 'Buffett Indicator' Surges Past 230%, But Does This Mean a Stock Market Crash is Imminent?
paras: 有「股神」之稱的巴菲特 (Warren Buffett) 並未預測美股即將崩盤，但他曾盛讚為「衡量市場估值水準的最佳單一指標」，如今卻升至歷史新高，引發市場對美股估值過熱的疑慮。
所謂「巴菲特指標」，是以威爾夏 5000 指數 (Wilshire 5000) 代表美國上市公司總市值，再除以美國國內生產毛額(GDP)。目前這項比率約達 230%，遠高於網路泡沫破裂前約 150% 的水準，表面看來，美股甚至比當年更加昂貴。
不過，巴菲特提出這項看法至今已經 25 年，市場結構也出現重大變化。威爾夏 5000 指數目前成分股早已不到 5000 家，甚至低於 4000 家；更重要的是，美國大型企業日益國際化，許多公司的營收與獲利來自海外，單純拿全球化企業的市值與美國國內經濟規模相比，可能產生失真。
FactSet 買方研究資深總監史瓦林 (Jonas Svallin) 因此依照企業在美國市場的營收占比調整數據。修正後的巴菲特指標僅約 144%，明顯低於原始版本的 230%；壞消息是，以歷史標準來看，美股估值仍處於相同程度的高檔。
史瓦林表示，美股目前「毫無疑問非常昂貴」，而且在利率不再處於異常低檔的情況下，這次估值極端化在某些方面甚至更加令人擔憂。低利率時期可以用資金成本便宜解釋高估值，如今這項理由已不再充分。
然而，這並不意味投資人應該立即清空股票。估值指標向來不擅長預測市場短期走勢，巴菲特指標多年前突破網路泡沫高點後，美股也未立刻崩盤。
伯克夏海瑟威的投資布局透露出較為謹慎的訊號。該公司仍在買進部分股票，但速度放慢、選股更加挑剔，資產負債表上的現金部位已高達 4000 億美元。這反映股票價格偏高，未來報酬可能難以超越現金，卻不代表市場即將暴跌。
史瓦林強調，投資並非只能在全押股票與完全離場之間二選一。巴菲特指標真正發出的警告是，經歷長期上漲與估值擴張後，投資人應降低對美股未來報酬的期待，接下來的長期表現可能低於歷史平均，而非一場崩盤必然迫在眉睫。
paras_en: Warren Buffett, known as the 'god of stocks', has not predicted a stock market crash, but he has praised the 'Buffett Indicator' as the 'best single measure' of market valuation. However, this indicator has now reached a historic high, sparking concerns about overvaluation in the US stock market.

The 'Buffett Indicator' is calculated by dividing the total market capitalization of US-listed companies, represented by the Wilshire 5000 index, by the US GDP. The current ratio is approximately 230%, far exceeding the 150% level before the dot-com bubble burst, making the US stock market appear even more expensive than it was back then.

However, it has been 25 years since Buffett introduced this concept, and the market structure has undergone significant changes. The Wilshire 5000 index now comprises fewer than 4,000 stocks, and many US companies generate revenue and profits from overseas, which may distort the comparison between their market capitalization and the US economy.

Jonas Svallin, senior director of FactSet's buy-side research, has adjusted the data according to the proportion of companies' revenue generated in the US market. The revised 'Buffett Indicator' is approximately 144%, significantly lower than the original 230%; however, by historical standards, the US stock market valuation remains at a high level.

Svallin stated that the US stock market is 'undoubtedly very expensive', and with interest rates no longer at unusually low levels, this extreme valuation is even more concerning. The low-interest-rate environment could previously be used to justify high valuations, but this reason is no longer sufficient.

This does not mean that investors should immediately sell their stocks. Valuation indicators have never been good at predicting short-term market trends, and the 'Buffett Indicator' exceeded the dot-com bubble high point years ago without the market immediately crashing.

The investment layout of Berkshire Hathaway reflects a more cautious signal. The company is still buying some stocks, but at a slower pace and with more selective stock-picking, with a cash position of over $400 billion on its balance sheet. This reflects that stock prices are high and future returns may be difficult to exceed cash, but it does not mean the market is about to crash.

Svallin emphasized that investing is not a binary choice between being fully invested in stocks or completely exiting the market. The 'Buffett Indicator' is actually warning that after a long period of growth and valuation expansion, investors should lower their expectations for future US stock market returns, which may be lower than the historical average, rather than a crash being imminent.

items.title: 7月半導體：AI需求推動全球漲價潮 代工與記憶體同步攀升
items.title_en: July Semiconductor: AI Demand Drives Global Price Surge, Foundry and Memory Synchronize Uptrend
paras: 7 月全球半導體市場在人工智慧 (AI) 強勁需求的推動下，展現出強大的增長動能，全球銷售額創下歷史新高。根據美國半導體行業協會 (SIA) 數據，2026 年 5 月全球半導體銷售額已首次突破 1200 億美元，年率大幅增長 104.1%。
同時，面對原材料、設備及電力成本的不斷攀升，晶圓代工大廠紛紛啟動新一輪漲價計畫。台積電已就 2027 年初的全面調價與客戶展開協商，先進製程與成熟製程的基礎漲幅預計在 5% 至 10% 之間。針對高性能計算 (HPC) 晶片的追加訂單，更可能加收 10% 至 15% 的溢價，部分訂單整體漲幅恐高達 25%。
三星電子則針對 4 奈米、5 奈米及車規 8 奈米等熱門製程，對新客戶調升報價約 15%。力積電在 7 月也展現強勢定價權，大幅上調 DRAM 代工加工費達 45%，並同步調升邏輯代工價格 10% 至 15%。力積電預期，這波漲價效益將在 11 月至 12 月反映於毛利率與營收，帶動業績階梯式成長。

記憶體量價齊升但漲幅邊際收斂 

記憶體產業已連續三個季度呈現漲價態勢，多項指標刷新歷史紀錄。根據機構預測，2026 年第三季 DRAM 合約價預計季增 13% 至 18%，但受消費端需求走弱影響，漲幅已有所收斂。
NAND Flash 方面，受 AI 推理與資料中心支撐，Q3 合約價預估季增 10% 至 15%。值得關注的是，由於產能受排擠，SLC NAND 供需缺口擴大，下半年價格可能出現翻倍式 (120% 至 170%) 的上漲。

手機與終端設備成本看漲 

半導體上游成本壓力正快速向下游傳導。高通 (Qualcomm) 已宣布 9 月起全線晶片調漲兩位數百分比，聯發科也有相關調價計畫。業界預測，這將直接推升下半年 Android 旗艦手機的售價。

企業布局與政策風向 

為應對長期需求，台積電大幅上調 2026 年資本支出至 600 億至 640 億美元，並持續擴大亞利桑那州投資。美光科技也計畫在 2035 年前將美國本土投資總額增至 2500 億美元。
政策面上，美國對 DRAM 裝置啟動的 337 調查，以及長鑫科技在科創板的高調上市，均為未來供應鏈增添了變數與競爭壓力。
paras_en: In July, the global semiconductor market showed strong growth momentum driven by robust demand for artificial intelligence (AI), with sales reaching a historic high. According to data from the US Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA), global semiconductor sales exceeded $120 billion for the first time in May 2026, with a significant year-over-year increase of 104.1%.

Facing rising costs of raw materials, equipment, and electricity, major foundries have initiated new price hikes. TSMC has begun negotiating a comprehensive price adjustment with customers for early 2027, with expected increases of 5% to 10% for advanced and mature processes. For high-performance computing (HPC) chips, additional orders may incur a premium of 10% to 15%, with some orders potentially seeing overall price increases of up to 25%.

Samsung Electronics has raised prices by around 15% for new customers on popular processes such as 4nm, 5nm, and automotive 8nm. Powerchip also demonstrated strong pricing power in July, significantly increasing DRAM processing fees by 45% and synchronously raising logic foundry prices by 10% to 15%. Powerchip expects the benefits of this price hike to be reflected in its gross margin and revenue in November and December, driving a step-by-step increase in performance.

The memory industry has seen price increases for three consecutive quarters, with multiple indicators reaching historic records. According to institutional forecasts, DRAM contract prices are expected to increase by 13% to 18% in the third quarter of 2026, but the growth rate has slowed due to weak demand from the consumer side.

In terms of NAND Flash, supported by AI inference and data centers, Q3 contract prices are expected to increase by 10% to 15%. Notably, due to production capacity constraints, the supply gap for SLC NAND is widening, and prices may see a doubling (120% to 170%) increase in the second half of the year.

The cost of upstream semiconductors is being rapidly passed on to downstream devices. Qualcomm has announced a double-digit percentage price increase for all chips starting in September, and MediaTek also has a price adjustment plan. The industry predicts that this will directly drive up the prices of Android flagship phones in the second half of the year.

To address long-term demand, TSMC has significantly increased its 2026 capital expenditure to $60 billion to $64 billion and continues to expand its investment in Arizona. Micron Technology also plans to increase its US investment to $250 billion by 2035.

In terms of policy, the US launch of a 337 investigation into DRAM devices and the high-profile listing of Huaxin Technology on the sci-tech board have added variables and competitive pressure to the future supply chain.

items.title: 賴清德：「長照3.0」今年起將失能身心障礙者納入服務對象
items.title_en: Tsai Ing-wen: 'Long-term Care 3.0' to Include Disabled and Mentally Challenged Individuals as Service Targets Starting This Year
paras: 總統賴清德今 (3) 日接見首屆「金唐獎」得獎者及入圍者，除了肯定所有得獎者及入圍者打破社會刻板印象，努力追求理想，也感謝所有基金會及家屬的長期陪伴。賴清德提到，政府從 2024 年起推動為期 5 年的計畫，預計至 2028 年投入超過 480 億元，布建身心障礙照顧服務，今 (2026) 年上路的「長照 3.0」，也將失能身心障礙者納入服務對象。
「長照 3.0」是台灣因應超高齡社會升級的長照政策，其核心重點為擴大服務對象、放寬外籍看護家庭限制、以及導入智慧科技輔具。
賴清德致詞時表示，長期以來很關心唐氏症者的照顧和發展，很敬佩唐氏症基金會及所有支持唐寶寶的基金會夥伴、企業與愛心家庭，「金唐獎」的設立是表揚唐氏症者，消除社會的刻板印象，平等欣賞每個人的能力、努力和成就。
賴清德表示，未來政府會從三個方向，讓支持更完整：第一個是權利，政府會持續落實《身心障礙者權利公約》，讓政策從「替你決定」走向「支持你選擇」；第二個是照顧：政府從 2024 年開始推動為期 5 年計畫，減輕照顧者負擔，擴增社區與機構服務。第三個是健康：「健康台灣」會落實全齡照顧、醫療平權和身心障礙者的健康權。
賴清德提到，行政院最近也通過全面提高老農津貼、國民年金及六大社福津貼，其中包括低收入戶家庭生活補助、低收入戶就學生活補助、低收入戶兒童生活補助、中低收入戶老人生活津貼、身心障礙者生活補助及弱勢兒童及少年生活扶助等，政府未來將持續關注弱勢家庭的生活照料。
paras_en: President Tsai Ing-wen met with the winners and nominees of the first 'Golden Tang Award' today, affirming all winners and nominees for breaking social stereotypes and pursuing their ideals, while also thanking the foundations and families for their long-term accompaniment. Tsai Ing-wen mentioned that the government will launch a 5-year plan starting from 2024, with an expected investment of over NT$480 billion by 2028, to establish care services for people with disabilities. The 'Long-term Care 3.0' program, which will be implemented this year (2026), will also include disabled and mentally challenged individuals as service targets.

'Long-term Care 3.0' is Taiwan's long-term care policy in response to the upgrading of the super-aging society, with its core focus on expanding service targets, relaxing restrictions on foreign caregivers, and introducing intelligent technology aids.

In her speech, Tsai Ing-wen expressed her long-term concern for the care and development of people with Down syndrome, and her admiration for the Down Syndrome Foundation and all the partners, companies, and loving families that support them. The establishment of the 'Golden Tang Award' is to commend people with Down syndrome, eliminate social stereotypes, and appreciate everyone's abilities, efforts, and achievements equally.

Tsai Ing-wen stated that in the future, the government will provide more comprehensive support from three directions: first, rights - the government will continue to implement the 'Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities', allowing policies to shift from 'deciding for you' to 'supporting your choices'; second, care - the government will launch a 5-year plan starting from 2024 to reduce the burden on caregivers and expand community and institutional services; third, health - 'Healthy Taiwan' will implement age-friendly care, medical equality, and the right to health for people with disabilities.

Tsai Ing-wen also mentioned that the Executive Yuan has recently passed a plan to comprehensively increase subsidies for elderly farmers, national pensions, and six major social welfare subsidies, including living allowances for low-income households, living allowances for low-income students, living allowances for low-income children, living subsidies for middle- and low-income elderly, living subsidies for people with disabilities, and living assistance for disadvantaged children and adolescents. The government will continue to pay attention to the living care of disadvantaged families in the future.

items.title: 佳必琪擬一年內加碼崧騰最多1成持股 每股價格上限60元
items.title_en: Chin Pao Ki to Increase Stake in Sungtop by up to 10% within a Year at a Price Cap of NT$60 per Share
paras: 連接線廠佳必琪 (6197-TW) 今 (3) 日公告，董事會決議擬自 2026 年 8 月 3 日至 2027 年 8 月 2 日止一年內自集中交易市場取得崧騰 (3484-TW) 不超過 10% 股權，每股價格 60 元內，交易總金額最高 4.23 億元。
佳必琪表示，此次取得股權目的為資產配置，增進資金運用效益，目前佳必琪持有崧騰 3381 張、約 4.289% 持股；旗下佳士麒投資則持有 1349 張、約 1.711% 持股；合計對崧騰持股 4730 張、持股比重 6%。
崧騰主要生產電控零組件產品，並擁有多款連接器、Busbar 產品線，已廣泛應用於電動車、儲能系統與伺服器機櫃等領域。
隨著雲端運算與 AI 應用快速擴展，資料中心對標準化與模組化平台的需求日益提升，OCP 架構成為全球基礎設施建置的重要趨勢，崧騰也持續推動產品與開放運算架構 (OCP, Open Compute Project) 的對接應用。
佳必琪近年積極衝刺 AI 電源布局，包括 ORV3 大電流電源線、Busflow 及 Busbar 等產品，均取得輝達 (NVDA-US) 及 OCP 雙重認證，並切入各大 CSP 與主要 ODM 供應鏈並量產出貨，成為下半年主要成長動能之一。
paras_en: Chin Pao Ki (6197-TW) announced on August 3 that its board of directors has decided to acquire up to a 10% stake in Sungtop (3484-TW) from the concentrated trading market between August 3, 2026, and August 2, 2027, with a price cap of NT$60 per share, and a total transaction amount of up to NT$423 million.

Chin Pao Ki stated that the purpose of this acquisition is for asset allocation and to enhance the efficiency of fund utilization. Currently, Chin Pao Ki holds 3,381 shares of Sungtop, approximately 4.289% of the company's shares, while its subsidiary, Chin Pao Ki Investment, holds 1,349 shares, approximately 1.711% of the company's shares. In total, Chin Pao Ki holds 4,730 shares of Sungtop, representing a 6% stake in the company.

Sungtop primarily produces electrical control component products and has multiple connector and Busbar product lines, which have been widely applied in the fields of electric vehicles, energy storage systems, and server cabinets.

As cloud computing and AI applications continue to expand rapidly, the demand for standardized and modular platforms in data centers is increasing. The OCP (Open Compute Project) architecture has become a major trend in global infrastructure construction, and Sungtop continues to promote the application of its products with OCP.

In recent years, Chin Pao Ki has been actively promoting its AI power layout, including ORV3 high-current power lines, Busflow, and Busbar products, all of which have obtained dual certification from NVIDIA (NVDA-US) and OCP. These products have entered the supply chains of major CSPs and ODMs and have been mass-produced and shipped, becoming one of the main growth drivers in the second half of the year.

items.title: 處置期縮短 首檔櫃買處置股適用新制將提前至8/10出關
items.title_en: Shortened Disposal Period: First OTC Stock to Benefit from New Regulations to be Released on 8/10
paras: 近期台股因波動劇烈，包括立委及市場高度關注，證交所、櫃買中心今 (3) 日下午分別緊急召開記者會，宣布修改含處置期間長短、撮合頻率等規則，新制於本 (8) 月 10 日起實施。櫃買今日也公告 1 檔處置股旭然 (4556-TW)，因處置期間屬新舊制交替期，原自明 (4) 日起處置至 8 月 17 日，現因新制而可在 8 月 10 日提前解除處置交易。
據證交所、櫃買公告，處置制度於 30 年以來首次變革，處置天數與撮合時間大幅鬆綁。其中，第一、第二次遭列處置的個股，其處置期間原為 10 個營業日，將縮短至 5 日，至於當沖占比較高的個股則為 7 日；撮合也從原定每 5 分鐘或 20 分鐘撮合一次，縮短為每 2 分鐘一次。
因市場新制將於 8 月 10 日上路，期間若仍處於處置期間股票，若於 8 月 10 日前已處置滿 5 日 (或當沖加重者滿 7 日)，則自 8 月 10 日起直接解除處置。
其中因櫃買中心今日公告新增處置股旭然，因最近 6 個交易日累積最後成交價跌幅達 40.8%，而遭列處置股。但因旭然處置期間剛好跨越新舊制交替，原訂舊制自 8 月 4 日起將處置至 8 月 17 日限制，因符合新制處置滿 5 個營業日規定，而提前於 8 月 10 日解除，成為首檔受惠於處置新制的個股。
依照公告，旭然明日處置仍為每 20 分鐘撮合一次，8 月 10 日的處置最終日將縮減為 2 分鐘撮合新制。
paras_en: Recently, the Taiwanese stock market has experienced significant fluctuations, drawing attention from lawmakers and the market. In response, the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the GreTai Securities Market held emergency press conferences on the 3rd, announcing amendments to the disposal period and matching frequency rules, which will take effect on August 10. The GreTai Securities Market also announced that one stock, Hsuan Yuan (4556-TW), will be subject to the new regulations, and its disposal period, originally scheduled from August 4 to August 17, will be shortened to end on August 10.

According to the announcements from the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the GreTai Securities Market, the disposal system has undergone its first major change in 30 years, significantly relaxing the disposal period and matching time. For stocks that are listed for disposal for the first or second time, the disposal period will be shortened from 10 business days to 5 days, while stocks with high intraday trading ratios will have a disposal period of 7 days. The matching frequency will also be increased from every 5 or 20 minutes to every 2 minutes.

As the new regulations will take effect on August 10, stocks that are still under disposal during this period will be directly removed from disposal if they have already been disposed of for 5 days (or 7 days for stocks with high intraday trading ratios) before August 10. Hsuan Yuan, which was announced as a new disposal stock by the GreTai Securities Market today, has seen a cumulative decline of 40.8% in its closing price over the past 6 trading days and has been listed for disposal. However, as its disposal period coincides with the transition between the old and new regulations, it will be released from disposal on August 10, becoming the first stock to benefit from the new disposal regulations.

According to the announcement, Hsuan Yuan's disposal will still be matched every 20 minutes tomorrow, but on August 10, the final day of its disposal, it will be matched every 2 minutes under the new regulations.

items.title: 舊制勞退歡迎「變新」！專家提醒報稅撇步：純舊制自提享3大稅務優惠
items.title_en: Old System Labor Retirement Welcomes "Change"! Experts Remind Taxation Steps: Pure Old System Self-Payment Enjoy 3 Tax Preferences
paras: 勞基法舊制勞工退休金新規上路，今年 7 月 17 日修正生效的勞工退休金條例施行細則，正式允許純舊制勞工每月在 6% 範圍內自願提繳退休金至個人專戶，同時符合條件者也可與雇主合意提前結算舊制退休金並全數移入專戶，享有新制最低收益保障與免計入當年度薪資所得等三大稅務優惠，為退休資產累積提供更多元管道。
勞工退休金條例施行細則 7 月修正生效後，新增規定讓純舊制勞工也能透過自願提繳累積退休資產。KPMG 安侯建業稅務投資部執業會計師陳志愷表示，本次修正核心目的在於讓純舊制勞工也能自提退休金，並透過提前結算舊制並移入個人專戶增加儲蓄與投資收益來源。雇主不得拒絕勞工提出的自提申請，且勞雇雙方合意結算的舊制退休金必須全數移入個人專戶，不得選擇部分或不移入。

在稅務影響方面，陳志愷指出本次修正涉及 3 項重要課稅重點。首先，自提退休金免計入當年度薪資所得，依月提繳工資分級表辦理不計入課稅。其次，提前結算並移入專戶的舊制退休金，因勞工尚未實際領取，移入時不課稅，待未來請領時再依退職所得規定辦理。最後，實際請領退休金時應依退職所得計算稅負，當勞工年滿 60 歲或喪失工作能力符合條件時，無論自提金、結算移入金或累積收益，均應併入退職所得，超過定額免稅標準部分才須課徵所得稅。
陳志愷進一步說明，若勞工於提前結算後持續服務所累積的舊制退休金並未移入專戶，而是在勞動契約終止時另行給付，為避免重複適用免稅額度，應與先前已自專戶請領的退休金合併計算退職所得，再就超過定額免稅標準部分課徵所得稅。陳志愷也提醒，本次修正雖將自提機制擴及純舊制勞工，但並未改變其適用舊制的身分，雇主無須為其提繳新制退休金，仍應依結算後持續工作所累積的舊制年資提撥退休準備金並認列相關費用。
paras_en: The new regulations for labor retirement under the old system have taken effect. The revised "Regulations for the Implementation of Labor Retirement Pension" that came into effect on July 17 this year allow pure old system laborers to voluntarily pay 6% of their retirement pension into their personal accounts every month. Those who meet the conditions can also agree with their employers to settle their old system retirement pension in advance and transfer it to their personal accounts, enjoying three tax benefits, including the minimum guaranteed return under the new system and exemption from inclusion in the current year's salary income, providing more channels for accumulating retirement assets.

After the revision of the "Regulations for the Implementation of Labor Retirement Pension" in July, new regulations allow pure old system laborers to accumulate retirement assets through voluntary payments. Chen Zhi-kai, a certified public accountant at KPMG, stated that the core purpose of this revision is to allow pure old system laborers to pay their retirement pension themselves and increase their savings and investment income through advance settlement of the old system and transfer to personal accounts. Employers cannot refuse laborers' applications for self-payment, and the old system retirement pension settled by both parties must be transferred to the personal account in full and cannot be partially or not transferred.

Regarding tax implications, Chen Zhi-kai pointed out that this revision involves three important tax points. Firstly, self-paid retirement pension is exempt from inclusion in the current year's salary income and is handled according to the monthly payment table without taxation. Secondly, the old system retirement pension that is settled in advance and transferred to a personal account is not taxed at the time of transfer since the laborer has not actually received it, and taxation will be handled according to the regulations for retirement income when it is claimed in the future. Lastly, when the retirement pension is actually claimed, the tax burden should be calculated according to the retirement income regulations. When the laborer is 60 years old or loses their working ability and meets the conditions, regardless of whether it is self-paid, settled, and transferred, or accumulated income, it should be included in the retirement income, and only the part exceeding the standard tax exemption will be subject to income tax.

Chen Zhi-kai further explained that if a laborer's old system retirement pension accumulated after advance settlement is not transferred to a personal account but is paid separately when the labor contract is terminated, to avoid duplicate application of tax exemption, it should be combined with the previously claimed retirement pension from the personal account to calculate the retirement income, and then the part exceeding the standard tax exemption will be subject to income tax. Chen Zhi-kai also reminded that although this revision has expanded the self-payment mechanism to pure old system laborers, it does not change their status under the old system, and employers do not need to pay new system retirement pension for them. They should still pay the retirement preparation fund according to the accumulated old system seniority after settlement and recognize the related expenses.

items.title: 賴清德：「長照3.0」今年起將失能身心障礙者納入服務對象
items.title_en: Tsai Ing-wen: 'Long-term Care 3.0' to Include Disabled and Mentally Challenged Individuals as Service Targets Starting This Year
paras: 總統賴清德今 (3) 日接見首屆「金唐獎」得獎者及入圍者，除了肯定所有得獎者及入圍者打破社會刻板印象，努力追求理想，也感謝所有基金會及家屬的長期陪伴。賴清德提到，政府從 2024 年起推動為期 5 年的計畫，預計至 2028 年投入超過 480 億元，布建身心障礙照顧服務，今 (2026) 年上路的「長照 3.0」，也將失能身心障礙者納入服務對象。
「長照 3.0」是台灣因應超高齡社會升級的長照政策，其核心重點為擴大服務對象、放寬外籍看護家庭限制、以及導入智慧科技輔具。
賴清德致詞時表示，長期以來很關心唐氏症者的照顧和發展，很敬佩唐氏症基金會及所有支持唐寶寶的基金會夥伴、企業與愛心家庭，「金唐獎」的設立是表揚唐氏症者，消除社會的刻板印象，平等欣賞每個人的能力、努力和成就。
賴清德表示，未來政府會從三個方向，讓支持更完整：第一個是權利，政府會持續落實《身心障礙者權利公約》，讓政策從「替你決定」走向「支持你選擇」；第二個是照顧：政府從 2024 年開始推動為期 5 年計畫，減輕照顧者負擔，擴增社區與機構服務。第三個是健康：「健康台灣」會落實全齡照顧、醫療平權和身心障礙者的健康權。
賴清德提到，行政院最近也通過全面提高老農津貼、國民年金及六大社福津貼，其中包括低收入戶家庭生活補助、低收入戶就學生活補助、低收入戶兒童生活補助、中低收入戶老人生活津貼、身心障礙者生活補助及弱勢兒童及少年生活扶助等，政府未來將持續關注弱勢家庭的生活照料。
paras_en: President Tsai Ing-wen met with the winners and nominees of the first 'Golden Tang Award' today, affirming all winners and nominees for breaking social stereotypes and pursuing their ideals, while also thanking the foundations and families for their long-term accompaniment. Tsai Ing-wen mentioned that the government will launch a 5-year plan starting from 2024, with an expected investment of over NT$480 billion by 2028, to establish care services for people with disabilities. The 'Long-term Care 3.0' program, which will be implemented this year (2026), will also include disabled and mentally challenged individuals as service targets.

'Long-term Care 3.0' is Taiwan's long-term care policy in response to the upgrading of the super-aging society, with its core focus on expanding service targets, relaxing restrictions on foreign caregivers, and introducing intelligent technology aids.

In her speech, Tsai Ing-wen expressed her long-term concern for the care and development of people with Down syndrome, and her admiration for the Down Syndrome Foundation and all the partners, companies, and loving families that support them. The establishment of the 'Golden Tang Award' is to commend people with Down syndrome, eliminate social stereotypes, and appreciate everyone's abilities, efforts, and achievements equally.

Tsai Ing-wen stated that in the future, the government will provide more comprehensive support from three directions: first, rights - the government will continue to implement the 'Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities', allowing policies to shift from 'deciding for you' to 'supporting your choices'; second, care - the government will launch a 5-year plan starting from 2024 to reduce the burden on caregivers and expand community and institutional services; third, health - 'Healthy Taiwan' will implement age-friendly care, medical equality, and the right to health for people with disabilities.

Tsai Ing-wen also mentioned that the Executive Yuan has recently passed a plan to comprehensively increase subsidies for elderly farmers, national pensions, and six major social welfare subsidies, including living allowances for low-income households, living allowances for low-income students, living allowances for low-income children, living subsidies for middle- and low-income elderly, living subsidies for people with disabilities, and living assistance for disadvantaged children and adolescents. The government will continue to pay attention to the living care of disadvantaged families in the future.

items.title: 瑞儀2個交易日買回4436張庫藏股 每股均價84.35元
items.title_en: Ruiyi Repurchases 4,436 Treasury Shares Over Two Trading Days at an Average Price of NT$84.35 per Share
paras: 背光模組廠瑞儀 (6176-TW) 今 (3) 日公告，已斥資 3.74 億元，買回 4436 張庫藏股，平均每股買回價格 84.35 元，本次庫藏股進行僅 2 個交易日，執行率已達 44%。
瑞儀預定自 7 月 31 日至 9 月 30 日買回 1 萬張庫藏股，買回區間價格 65-100 元，股價低於區間價格下限，將繼續買回，預定買回股份占公司已發行股份總數之比率 2.87%，買回股份將轉讓予員工。
瑞儀上半年營收 231.24 億元，年減 6%，毛利率 21.91%，年增 0.25 個百分點，營業利益 28.57 億元，年增 24.6%，營業利益率 10.12%，年減 1.37 個百分點，稅後純益 12.92 億元，年減 28.6%，每股純益 2.81 元。
瑞儀說明，車載產品營收占比持續提升，AI PC 也加入成長動能，消費性電子因全球供應鏈產能受 AI、高效能運算伺服器 (HPC) 需求排擠，導致邏輯晶片與記憶體等關鍵零組件交期延宕且價格高漲，終端產品訂單波動影響整體出貨。
展望下半年，瑞儀認為，消費性電子產品展望穩健，預期背光模組需求不墜，營收貢獻有望與上半年持平；車載產品則展現出強勁的轉型動能，目前正處於新舊機種切換期，整體呈現「量縮價增」趨勢。
瑞儀目前為 Mercedes-Benz、BMW、和 Audi 三大歐系車廠車載顯示器主要背光模組供應商，並取得複數年供應合約，隨著歐系一線車廠新車款陸續推出，公司對全年車載產品的展望保持樂觀向上。
另外，瑞儀也看好 AI PC 為公司注入新成長動能，針對 AI PC 高效能運作下更為嚴苛的顯示器技術規格要求，瑞儀憑藉高亮度背光模組成功切入輝達 (NVIDIA)(NVDA-US)RTX Spark AI PC 供應鏈，可望進一步優化產品組合。
paras_en: Backlight module manufacturer Ruiyi (6176-TW) announced today (the 3rd) that it has spent NT$374 million to repurchase 4,436 treasury shares at an average price of NT$84.35 per share. The repurchase was completed in just two trading days, achieving a 44% execution rate.

Ruiyi plans to repurchase 10,000 treasury shares between July 31 and September 30, with a price range of NT$65‑100 per share. If the market price falls below the lower bound, the company will continue buying. The intended repurchase would represent 2.87% of the company’s total issued shares and the shares will be transferred to employees.

In the first half of the year, Ruiyi reported revenue of NT$23.124 billion, down 6% year‑over‑year, with a gross margin of 21.91%, up 0.25 percentage points. Operating profit was NT$2.857 billion, up 24.6% YoY, and the operating margin was 10.12%, down 1.37 percentage points. Net profit after tax was NT$1.292 billion, down 28.6% YoY, equating to earnings of NT$2.81 per share.

Ruiyi explained that the share of revenue from automotive products continues to rise, and AI PCs are adding to growth momentum. In consumer electronics, global supply‑chain capacity is being squeezed by demand for AI and high‑performance computing (HPC) servers, causing delays and price hikes for key components such as logic chips and memory, which in turn makes end‑product orders volatile and impacts overall shipments.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, Ruiyi believes the outlook for consumer electronics remains solid, expecting backlight‑module demand to stay stable and revenue contribution to match the first half. Automotive products, meanwhile, are showing strong transformation momentum; the segment is currently in a transition between old and new models and is exhibiting a "lower volume, higher price" trend.

Ruiyi is currently a primary backlight‑module supplier for automotive displays of the three major European car makers—Mercedes‑Benz, BMW, and Audi—and has secured multi‑year supply contracts. As these OEMs roll out new models, the company remains optimistic about its full‑year automotive product outlook.

In addition, Ruiyi is bullish on AI PCs as a new growth driver. To meet the stricter display‑technology specifications required by high‑performance AI PCs, Ruiyi’s high‑brightness backlight modules have successfully entered NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) RTX Spark AI PC supply chains, which should further enhance its product portfolio.

items.title: 台股7月跌6.5%消化風險溢價 聯博點出基本面具韌性關鍵原因
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Dropped 6.5% in July to Digest Risk Premium, UBS Finds Resilience in Fundamentals
paras: 台股歷經 7 月大幅修正後，聯博投信指出，本波回檔主要反映市場重新定價，基本面未見惡化，評價面已回落至合理水準，隨著長期成長動能仍在，投資價值已逐漸浮現，建議透過主動選股掌握震盪後的布局機會。
台股上週上演戲劇性反攻，週初指數一度受壓，隨後在權值股與低接買盤帶動下強勢反彈，單日創下史上最大收盤漲點紀錄，終場收在 43119.75 點，總計 7 月單月大跌 3006.16 點，跌幅達 6.5%。
聯博投信副總經理林炳魁表示，近期台股波動加劇，主因市場對人工智慧資本支出趨勢及貨幣政策走向存疑，導致情緒快速降溫，但這波修正反而使中期投資前景更具吸引力。
林炳魁分析，台股 7 月經歷兩次顯著回檔，與過去因經濟衰退引發的空頭市場不同，本次主要反映成長速度的重新定價，台灣經濟基本面依然穩健，全球對先進半導體、人工智慧基礎設施與高效能運算的需求持續擴張，科技龍頭企業獲利展望正向，核心動能未改。
此外，加權股價指數本益比已回到長期歷史平均水準，評價調整速度超越基本面變化，提供投資人以更具吸引力的價格布局優質企業的機會。
歷史經驗顯示，當市場因不確定性大幅修正且未伴隨經濟衰退時，後續 3 個月、6 個月及 12 個月的報酬表現通常較為正面。面對波動與產業分化，主動投資重要性提升，如 00404A 聯博台灣動能收益 50 主動式 ETF 透過主動選股，聚焦具競爭優勢的企業，並動態調整配置，核心仍以半導體等科技成長產業為主，並透過多元產業配置提升投資組合韌性。
paras_en: After experiencing a significant correction in July, UBS Asset Management pointed out that the recent rebound mainly reflects the market's re-pricing, with no deterioration in fundamentals. The valuation has returned to a reasonable level, and with long-term growth momentum still in place, investment value has gradually emerged, suggesting that investors should seize the opportunity to layout through active stock picking.

The Taiwan stock market staged a dramatic rebound last week, with the index initially under pressure at the beginning of the week, but then strongly rebounded driven by large-cap stocks and low-absorbing buying, setting a record for the largest single-day gain, closing at 43,119.75 points. The total decline in July was 3,006.16 points, a drop of 6.5%.

Lin Bingkui, Vice President of UBS Asset Management, stated that the recent fluctuations in the Taiwan stock market are mainly due to market doubts about the trend of artificial intelligence capital expenditures and monetary policy, leading to a rapid decline in sentiment. However, this correction has made the medium-term investment outlook more attractive.

Lin Bingkui analyzed that the Taiwan stock market experienced two significant corrections in July, which is different from the bear market caused by economic recession in the past. This time, it mainly reflects the re-pricing of growth rates. The fundamentals of Taiwan's economy remain stable, and the global demand for advanced semiconductors, artificial intelligence infrastructure, and high-performance computing continues to expand. The profit outlook for technology leading companies is positive, and the core momentum has not changed.

Additionally, the price-to-earnings ratio of the weighted stock price index has returned to its long-term historical average, with the valuation adjustment speed surpassing the change in fundamentals, providing investors with a more attractive price to layout high-quality companies.

Historical experience shows that when the market corrects significantly due to uncertainty without accompanying economic recession, the subsequent 3-month, 6-month, and 12-month returns are usually more positive. In the face of fluctuations and industry differentiation, the importance of active investment is enhanced. For example, the 00404A UBS Taiwan Dynamic 50 Active ETF, through active stock picking, focuses on companies with competitive advantages and dynamically adjusts its configuration, with a core focus on the semiconductor and other technology growth industries, and enhances the resilience of the investment portfolio through diversified industry configuration.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯不同調！重貶1.46角守住32.5元關卡 高低價差近3角
items.title_en: NT Dollar Plunges 1.46 Points to 32.5 Yuan Threshold, High-Low Price Difference Reaches Nearly 3 Points
paras: 台北股匯今 (3) 日表現不同調，大盤持續反彈逾 260 點，新台幣兌美元匯率先升後貶，外資轉向匯出，匯價單日高低價差高達近 3 角，但央行強力穩匯，帶動貶幅收斂，終場收在 32.438 元，重貶 1.46 角，台北與元太外匯總成交值爆出 39.2 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天以 32.26 元開盤後，一度升抵 32.21 元、升值 8.2 分，但外資與進口商聯手買匯，使得匯價應聲翻黑，接連失守 32.3、32.4 元兩道關卡，最低下探 32.49 元、重貶近 2 角，與強勢日元走勢明顯脫鉤。
考量短線貶勢過於猛烈，且與整體亞洲貨幣走勢脫鉤，央行隨即擴大防守力道，力保 32.5 元整數關卡不失。在尾盤調節下，貶幅逐步收斂，終場收在 32.438 元，單日貶值 1.46 角。
美伊談判樂觀情緒升溫，原油重挫逾 4%，美元指數應聲跌破 100 大關，加上美日聯手干預匯市，推升日元單日飆升 2.18%，韓元同步升值 0.16%；人民幣小貶 0.08%，新台幣重貶 0.45%，成本日最弱亞幣。
台股今天上漲 266.66 點，收在 43386.41 點，權王台積電走弱，但聯發科、日月光投控帶動亮燈漲停，被動元件、CPO、記憶體、載板等族群表現強勢，亦有多檔攻上漲停。外資則賣超台股近 192 億元。
paras_en: The Taipei stock and foreign exchange markets performed differently today (3rd), with the index rebounding by over 260 points. The New Taiwan dollar exchange rate against the US dollar first rose and then fell, with foreign investors turning to sell, resulting in a high-low price difference of nearly 3 points. However, the central bank's strong intervention stabilized the exchange rate, and the final closing price was 32.438 yuan, a depreciation of 1.46 points, with a total transaction value of USD 3.92 billion in the Taipei and Yuanta foreign exchange markets.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.26 yuan against the US dollar today and once rose to 32.21 yuan, appreciating by 8.2 points. However, foreign investors and importers jointly bought foreign exchange, causing the exchange rate to plummet, breaking through the 32.3 and 32.4 yuan thresholds, with the lowest point reaching 32.49 yuan, a depreciation of nearly 2 points, which was significantly disconnected from the strong yen trend.

Considering the short-term depreciation trend was too intense and deviated from the overall trend of Asian currencies, the central bank expanded its defensive efforts to protect the 32.5 yuan threshold. After adjustments in the final stages, the depreciation gradually narrowed, and the final closing price was 32.438 yuan, with a single-day depreciation of 1.46 points.

As optimism about US-Iran negotiations increased, crude oil prices plummeted by over 4%, and the US dollar index fell below the 100 threshold. Additionally, the joint US-Japan intervention in the foreign exchange market boosted the yen by 2.18% and the Korean won by 0.16%. The renminbi depreciated by 0.08%, while the New Taiwan dollar depreciated by 0.45%, becoming the weakest currency in Asia. The Taiwan stock market rose by 266.66 points to 43,386.41 points, with TSMC weakening but MediaTek and ASE Technology Holding leading the gains, and many stocks reaching their daily limits.

items.title: 2025來台旅客觀光支出年增1成 美國觀光客日均消費242美元最高
items.title_en: 2025 Taiwan Tourism Spending Increases by 10%, with American Tourists Spending the Most at $242 per Day
paras: 交通部觀光署今 (3) 日公布「114 年來台旅客消費及動向調查」結果，去 (2025) 年來台旅客共計 857 萬 4,547 人次，較 2024 年增 9.12％，旅客在台觀光總支出為 110.33 億美元（約新台幣 3,438.57 億元），較 2024 年增加 10.02%，消費水準成長速度高於旅客人次成長 0.9 個百分點，以美國旅客每人每日消費 242.84 美元最高。
觀光署表示，據調查顯示，來台旅客持續成長的同時，觀光產值及市場效益同步提升，客源結構也持續朝多元化發展，台灣觀光正逐步由追求人次規模，邁向兼顧品質、效益及市場價值的新階段。
數據顯示，去年來台觀光客，平均每人每日消費 185.14 美元，較 2024 年增加 1.26%、平均停留 6.95 夜，來台旅客在持續成長的同時，觀光產值及市場效益同步提升，客源結構也持續朝多元化發展，
觀光署表示，本次調查揭示五大趨勢，包括「旅遊決策提前」、「自由行持續深化」、「體驗型消費成長」、「旅遊內容持續深化」及「多元市場共同支撐觀光成長動能」，反映國際旅客來臺旅遊型態、消費模式及市場結構持續轉變，也反映臺灣觀光競爭力已逐步由景點吸引，延伸至文化特色、生活體驗、服務品質及市場經營能力。
調查中也發現，去年國際旅客平均於出發前 46.74 天開始規劃來台旅程，較 2024 年提早 5.69 天；純自由行旅客比例達 76.4%，為主要旅遊型態。影響旅客最終來臺決策的重要資訊來源，以個人遊記 67.58%、旅客評論 59.31% 居前，顯示真實旅遊經驗分享及社群口碑，已成為國際旅遊市場競爭的重要關鍵，代表國際觀光競爭已由旅遊期間，提前至旅客行前決策階段。
觀光署說，不同旅遊目的展現不同觀光價值，以度假、休閒及遊憩為目的的旅客仍是來台旅遊的重要基礎；而國際會議及展覽旅客平均每人每日消費 274.51 美元、業務旅客 235.38 美元，均高於整體平均 185.14 美元，展現高附加價值。
值得注意的ˊ，國際會議及展覽旅客平均每人每日娛樂支出 13.59 美元，較前年 9.57 美元成長 42%，顯示會展旅客除參與會議展覽外，也逐步投入更多文化、休閒及地方體驗，帶動整體觀光效益提升。
以客源來看，去 (2025) 年度日本為最大單一客源市場，占 17.3%；區域市場觀察，新南向主力 7 國占來台旅客 30.07%，全年觀光總支出達 37.25 億美元，占整體觀光總支出 33.76%，為各區域之首。
此外，菲律賓來台旅客人次達年增 123.11%、印度 114.33%、紐澳 109.05%、越南 105.11%、歐洲 104.33% 及印尼 102.26%，均已超越疫情前 (2019 年) 水準，顯示台灣近年積極拓展多元國際市場已展現成果，也讓國際客源結構更加均衡、多元且具韌性。
paras_en: The Tourism Bureau of the Ministry of Transportation announced the results of the '114 Annual Survey of Visitor Consumption and Trends' on the 3rd, which showed that the number of visitors to Taiwan in 2025 reached 8,574,547, a 9.12% increase from 2024. The total tourism expenditure was $11.033 billion (approximately NT$3,438.57 billion), a 10.02% increase from 2024, with American tourists spending the most at $242.84 per day.

The Tourism Bureau stated that while the number of visitors to Taiwan continues to grow, the tourism industry's value and market benefits are also increasing, with the source of tourists becoming more diversified. Taiwan's tourism is transitioning from focusing on the number of visitors to a new stage that prioritizes quality, benefits, and market value.

According to the data, the average daily expenditure of tourists in 2025 was $185.14, a 1.26% increase from 2024, with an average stay of 6.95 nights. The Tourism Bureau pointed out that the survey revealed five major trends, including 'earlier travel decisions', 'in-depth independent travel', 'experiential consumption growth', 'deeper travel content', and 'diversified markets supporting tourism growth', reflecting the changing travel styles, consumption patterns, and market structures of international tourists in Taiwan.

The survey also found that international tourists started planning their trips to Taiwan an average of 46.74 days in advance, 5.69 days earlier than in 2024. A total of 76.4% of tourists traveled independently, making it the primary travel style. The most important sources of information for tourists' decision-making were personal travel blogs (67.58%) and tourist reviews (59.31%), indicating that real travel experiences and social word-of-mouth have become key factors in international tourism competition.

The Tourism Bureau noted that different travel purposes exhibit different tourism values. Tourists traveling for vacation, leisure, and recreation remain the foundation of Taiwan's tourism. However, international conference and exhibition tourists spent an average of $274.51 per day, and business travelers spent $235.38 per day, both higher than the overall average of $185.14, demonstrating high added value.

Notably, international conference and exhibition tourists spent an average of $13.59 per day on entertainment, a 42% increase from the previous year's $9.57, indicating that these tourists are not only participating in conferences and exhibitions but also investing in cultural, leisure, and local experiences, driving the overall growth of tourism benefits.

In terms of tourist sources, Japan was the largest single source market in 2025, accounting for 17.3%. In terms of regional markets, the 'New Southbound' countries accounted for 30.07% of tourists, with a total tourism expenditure of $3.725 billion, accounting for 33.76% of the total tourism expenditure, making it the leading region.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉美伊緊張局勢降溫、油價跌破80美元 主要指數開高
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Higher as U.S.-Iran Tensions Ease and Oil Falls Below $80
paras: 美股主要指數周一 (3 日) 開高，美國總統川普取消原定對伊朗發動的攻擊，中東緊張局勢出現降溫希望，帶動國際油價重挫、西德州原油跌破每桶 80 美元，緩解市場對能源價格推升通膨的擔憂。
風險偏好回升，加上企業財報表現穩健，道瓊指數早盤一度大漲逾 600 點，美國公債同步走高、殖利率下滑。投資人本周也將迎來密集的企業財報與重要經濟數據。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近 600 點或 1.1%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近 220 點或 近 0.9%，標普 500 指數漲 0.7%，費城半導體指數跌 2.9%。台積電 ADR 跌近 0.8%。
美伊緊張局勢出現降溫跡象，國際油價周一一度暴跌逾 7%，緩解市場對能源成本推升通膨、迫使利率長期維持高檔的擔憂，帶動美股期指與美國公債同步上漲。
標普 500 指數期貨上漲 0.5%，為本周美股開出紅盤增添希望。美國總統川普取消原定對伊朗發動的軍事攻擊後，布蘭特原油期貨一度重挫 7.3%，跌至每桶 81.55 美元。
美債殖利率全面下降，指標 10 年期美債殖利率下滑 6 個基點至 4.68%，脫離今年 1 月以來最高水準。彭博美元指數則下跌 0.1%。
IG 駐巴黎首席市場分析師 Alexandre Baradez 表示，地緣政治消息帶動油價下降，也減輕債券殖利率的上行壓力。不過，美債殖利率、金融槓桿與聯準會 (Fed) 政策仍存在問題，在這些不確定性消除前，還不能斷言股市已完全擺脫風險。

荷姆茲海峽協商傳進展 市場等待和平協議

伊朗周一透露，讓船舶恢復通行荷姆茲海峽的談判正取得進展。川普先前也表示，在取消攻擊伊朗後，美伊兩國將恢復協商。
美伊戰爭引發的供應緊縮已推高燃料成本，加深市場對新一波通膨的擔憂。AT Global Markets 首席市場分析師 Nick Twidale 表示，如果美伊達成具體和平協議，或更重要的是荷姆茲海峽重新開放，全球市場可能出現強勁的紓壓反彈。
不過，《彭博》策略師警告，原油市場仍不能將美伊衝突拋在腦後，價格風險依舊偏向上行。選擇權市場對油價上漲的擔憂仍高於下跌，顯示交易員認為供應衝擊再次推高布蘭特原油的可能性，仍大於油價持續大幅下滑。
除中東局勢外，AI 類股估值與通膨風險仍主導市場走勢。投資人本周將密切關注周五公布的美國 7 月就業報告，藉此研判 Fed 下一步政策。SpaceX 則將於周二公布上市後首份財報，歐洲企業匯豐與諾和諾德也將發布業績。
個股方面，百時美施貴寶盤前大漲逾 8%，消息傳出英國製藥大廠阿斯特捷利康曾研究收購這家公司；阿斯特捷利康在倫敦重挫逾 7%。萬豪國際因獲利展望不佳下跌 3.7%。
歐洲道瓊 600 指數上漲 0.4%，消費品與汽車類股領漲。亞洲股市則普遍走低，南韓晶片股大跌，顯示 AI 概念股的劇烈震盪尚未結束。

日元劇烈震盪 美日不排除再次聯手干預

日元周一早盤先跌後升，兌美元一度大漲 1.4%，隨後吐回大部分漲幅，倫敦盤交易於 156.90 附近。市場猜測，美日上周協調干預後，官方可能再次進場買進日元，但部分波動也可能來自緊張的交易員或演算法交易。
日本財務省證實，美日已於美國時間 7 月 31 日協調進行買進日元的操作，若有必要，不會猶豫再次聯手干預。美國財長貝森特表示，美方出手是為了遏止日元「失序」波動，未來也準備繼續協助日本，並提到日本可使用 Fed 的一項融通機制。
野村國際北亞投資長 Julia Wang 預期，未來一周日元可能繼續震盪，並出現暫時性走強；但干預措施並未改變美元兌日元的實際方向，一旦官方操作結束，美元兌日元仍可能重新走高。

摩根士丹利將韓股評等由「中立」上調至「優於大盤」，認為近期槓桿部位大幅退場，已為投資人重新布局人工智慧 (AI) 與工業超級循環題材提供更好的進場點。該行指出，韓國綜合股價指數 (KOSPI) 距離 9000 點目標仍有約 36% 上漲空間，近期跌勢主要由技術性因素造成，槓桿型 ETF、避險基金及散戶融資部位的去槓桿進程已經過半。KOSPI 自 6 月高點以來累計下跌逾 30%。
韓股身為亞洲 AI 需求的重要風向球，近期因市場迅速撤出資金，加上個股槓桿型 ETF 盛行及指數權重過度集中，跌勢進一步加劇。摩根士丹利預估，KOSPI 短期可能在 5500 點至 10500 點間波動，三星電子與 SK 海力士可望提供估值支撐；工業、國防及金融類股也有機會受惠於基本面利多。
paras_en: U.S. equity indexes opened higher on Monday (the 3rd) as President Trump cancelled the planned attack on Iran, raising hopes that Middle‑East tensions are cooling. The news sent international oil prices plunging, with West Texas Intermediate falling below $80 a barrel, easing market worries that energy costs could fuel inflation.

Risk appetite rebounded and corporate earnings were solid, sending the Dow Jones Industrial Average up more than 600 points in early trade, while U.S. Treasury yields fell. Investors this week also face a packed schedule of corporate earnings and key economic data.

Just before the deadline, the Dow was up about 600 points or 1.1%, the Nasdaq Composite rose roughly 220 points or about 0.9%, the S&P 500 gained 0.7%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index slipped 2.9%. Taiwan Semiconductor ADR fell about 0.8%.

Signs of a de‑escalation in U.S.–Iran tensions saw oil prices plunge more than 7% on Monday, easing concerns that energy costs would push inflation higher and force rates to stay elevated, which in turn lifted U.S. futures and Treasury bonds.

S&P 500 futures rose 0.5%, adding optimism to a week of mostly red sessions for U.S. stocks. After Trump scrapped the planned military strike on Iran, Brent crude futures tumbled 7.3% to $81.55 a barrel.
U.S. Treasury yields fell across the board, with the benchmark 10‑year yield down six basis points to 4.68%, slipping from its peak since January. Bloomberg’s dollar index slipped 0.1%.

IG’s chief market analyst in Paris, Alexandre Baradez, said geopolitical news drove oil lower and also eased upward pressure on bond yields. However, he warned that Treasury yields, financial leverage and Fed policy still pose risks, and until those uncertainties are cleared the market cannot claim to be out of danger.

Progress reported in Houthi‑controlled Strait of Hormuz talks and markets await a peace deal. Iran said on Monday that negotiations to reopen the strait were making headway, and Trump had earlier said that after canceling the attack, the U.S. and Iran would resume talks.

The war‑driven supply squeeze had lifted fuel costs and deepened worries about a new wave of inflation. AT Global Markets’ chief analyst Nick Twidale said that a concrete peace agreement—or, more importantly, the reopening of the strait—could spark a strong relief rally in global markets.

But Bloomberg strategists cautioned that the oil market cannot ignore the U.S.–Iran conflict, and price risk remains skewed higher. Options markets show more concern about oil rising than falling, indicating traders still see a higher chance of supply shocks pushing Brent up again rather than a sustained sharp decline.

Beyond the Middle East, AI‑related stock valuations and inflation risk continue to dominate market direction. Investors will watch Friday’s U.S. July jobs report closely to gauge the Fed’s next move. SpaceX will release its first post‑IPO earnings on Tuesday, and European firms HSBC and Novo Nordisk are also slated to report.

On the equity side, Bristol‑Myers Squibb jumped more than 8% pre‑market after rumors that UK drugmaker AstraZeneca had explored a takeover; AstraZeneca fell more than 7% in London. Marriott International slid 3.7% after a weak profit outlook.
Europe’s DAX 600 rose 0.4%, led by consumer and auto stocks. Asian markets were broadly lower, with South Korean chip stocks tumbling, showing that the AI‑stock volatility has not yet subsided.

The yen swung sharply on Monday, first falling then rising, spiking 1.4% against the dollar before giving back most of the gain and trading near 156.90 in the London session. Markets speculate that after coordinated intervention last week, officials may step in again, though some of the movement may stem from nervous traders or algorithmic activity.

Japan’s finance ministry confirmed that Japan and the U.S. coordinated a yen‑buying operation on July 31 (U.S. time) and would not hesitate to intervene again if needed. U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen said the action was meant to curb “disorderly” yen moves and that the U.S. stands ready to continue assisting Japan, noting Japan could tap a Fed liquidity facility.

Nomura International’s North Asia head Julia Wang expects the yen to remain volatile and possibly see a temporary bounce this week, but she says intervention has not changed the underlying dollar‑yen trend; once official action ends, the dollar could resume its rise against the yen.

As of about 21:00 Taipei time on Monday (the 3rd): Dow Jones Industrial Average up 659.95 points or 1.26% at 53,144.98; Nasdaq Composite up 95.23 points or 0.38% at 25,469.09; S&P 500 up 41.14 points or 0.55% at 7,530.86; Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 375.12 points or 3.32% at 10,935.95; Taiwan Semiconductor ADR down 1.29% to $399.08; 10‑year Treasury yield down to 4.68%; NY light crude down 6.37% to $79.28 a barrel; Brent crude down 4.94% to $83.59 a barrel; gold down 0.45% to $4,088.60 an ounce; dollar index down to 99.79.

Key stocks: AstraZeneca (AZN‑US) fell 7.62% in early trade to $156.72. The Financial Times reported AstraZeneca and Bristol‑Myers Squibb (BMY‑US) are discussing a merger, causing divergent moves – AstraZeneca down more than 4% pre‑market, Bristol‑Myers up over 5%. Alibaba (BABA‑US) rose 4.60% to $127.87 after unveiling its new AI model Qwen 3.8‑Max, one of its most powerful to date, slated for release next week. Micron (MU‑US) fell 3.79% to $791.82; memory stocks were broadly lower after last week’s volatility, with SanDisk (SNDK‑US) and Micron each down over 3% and Seagate (STX‑US) down 2.5%.
Today's key economic data: U.S. July ISM manufacturing index expected at 54.0 (previous 53.3); U.S. July manufacturing PMI final expected at 53.8 (previous 53.8).

Wall Street analysis: Morgan Stanley upgraded its rating on Korean equities from “neutral” to “outperform,” citing a recent sharp retreat of leveraged positions that creates a better entry point for AI and industrial super‑cycle themes. The firm sees the KOSPI still having about 36% upside to a 9,000‑point target, noting the recent decline was largely technical and that de‑leveraging of leveraged ETFs, hedge funds and retail margin has passed the halfway point. The KOSPI has fallen more than 30% since its June peak. Korean stocks, a key gauge of Asian AI demand, have been hit hard by rapid fund outflows, the prevalence of leveraged ETFs and concentration in index weights, amplifying the drop. Morgan Stanley projects the KOSPI could swing between 5,500 and 10,500 points in the short term, with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix providing valuation support; industrial, defense and financial stocks may also benefit from favorable fundamentals.

items.title: KKR斥資57億美元收購Integer趁估值回落布局醫療器材供應鏈
items.title_en: KKR Spends $5.7 Billion to Acquire Integer as Valuation Falls, Expanding Medical Device Supply Chain
paras: 2026年08月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 私募基金KKR宣布，將以全現金交易收購醫療器材&器械製造商Integer Holdings(ITGR-US)，交易總價約57億美元，完成後Integer將下市，成為KKR旗下非上市公司。
消息公布後，Integer盤前股價上漲近3%。根據協議，KKR將以每股127美元現金收購Integer，較8月1日收盤價溢價4.78%，交易內容亦包含承接Integer既有債務。
由於醫療器材&器械產業具有需求穩定、切入門檻高的特性。當短期市況不佳導致企業估值回落時，往往成為私募基金布局的時機。Integer近兩季因部分新產品導入速度不如預期，以及電生理（EP）產品客戶調整庫存與需求預測，下修2026年營運展望，短期逆風壓抑市場評價，也提供KKR等長線投資人趁勢布局的機會。
根據統計，目前Integer交易在18.4倍預估本益比，略低於同業公司平均的19.7倍。
Integer總部位於美國德州普萊諾（Plano），主要為全球大型醫療器材&器械廠商提供關鍵零組件與產品，應用涵蓋心臟治療、疼痛管理及其他醫療技術領域，是醫療器材供應鏈的重要廠商。
近年私募基金持續加碼醫療產業投資，包括American Industrial Partners以12.7億美元收購Avanos Medical，以及Blackstone與TPG以183億美元收購專注女性健康檢測的Hologic，都顯示醫療產業仍是併購熱門領域。
截至2026年第二季底，KKR管理資產規模達7,960億美元。此次收購是KKR自2018年以99億美元收購Envision Healthcare以來，在醫療領域規模最大的交易之一。

paras_en: On August 3, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Private‑equity firm KKR announced it will acquire medical device and equipment manufacturer Integer Holdings (ITGR‑US) in an all‑cash transaction valued at roughly $5.7 billion. After the deal closes, Integer will be delisted and become a privately held KKR subsidiary.

Following the announcement, Integer’s pre‑market share rose about 3%. Under the agreement, KKR will pay $127 in cash per share, a 4.78% premium to the closing price on August 1, and the deal also includes assuming Integer’s existing debt.

Because the medical device and equipment sector features stable demand and high entry barriers, valuation declines during short‑term market weakness often create buying opportunities for private‑equity funds. Integer trimmed its 2026 operating outlook after slower‑than‑expected roll‑out of some new products and inventory and demand adjustments by its electrophysiology (EP) customers, which dampened its short‑term market valuation and opened a window for long‑term investors such as KKR to step in.
According to the data, the Integer transaction is priced at an estimated 18.4‑times forward earnings, slightly below the industry average of 19.7 times.

Integer is headquartered in Plano, Texas, and supplies key components and products to large global medical‑device manufacturers across cardiac therapy, pain management and other medical‑technology fields, making it an important player in the medical‑device supply chain.

In recent years, private‑equity firms have continued to increase investments in the healthcare sector, including American Industrial Partners’ $1.27 billion acquisition of Avanos Medical and Blackstone and TPG’s $18.3 billion purchase of women‑health diagnostics company Hologic, underscoring the sector’s ongoing M&A appeal.

As of the end of Q2 2026, KKR’s assets under management total $796 billion. This acquisition is one of the largest healthcare deals for KKR since its $9.9 billion purchase of Envision Healthcare in 2018.
