items.title: 「巴菲特指標」衝破230%狂閃紅燈 美股真的要崩盤了嗎？
items.title_en: The 'Buffett Indicator' Surges Past 230%, But Does This Mean a Stock Market Crash is Imminent?
paras: 有「股神」之稱的巴菲特 (Warren Buffett) 並未預測美股即將崩盤，但他曾盛讚為「衡量市場估值水準的最佳單一指標」，如今卻升至歷史新高，引發市場對美股估值過熱的疑慮。
所謂「巴菲特指標」，是以威爾夏 5000 指數 (Wilshire 5000) 代表美國上市公司總市值，再除以美國國內生產毛額(GDP)。目前這項比率約達 230%，遠高於網路泡沫破裂前約 150% 的水準，表面看來，美股甚至比當年更加昂貴。
不過，巴菲特提出這項看法至今已經 25 年，市場結構也出現重大變化。威爾夏 5000 指數目前成分股早已不到 5000 家，甚至低於 4000 家；更重要的是，美國大型企業日益國際化，許多公司的營收與獲利來自海外，單純拿全球化企業的市值與美國國內經濟規模相比，可能產生失真。
FactSet 買方研究資深總監史瓦林 (Jonas Svallin) 因此依照企業在美國市場的營收占比調整數據。修正後的巴菲特指標僅約 144%，明顯低於原始版本的 230%；壞消息是，以歷史標準來看，美股估值仍處於相同程度的高檔。
史瓦林表示，美股目前「毫無疑問非常昂貴」，而且在利率不再處於異常低檔的情況下，這次估值極端化在某些方面甚至更加令人擔憂。低利率時期可以用資金成本便宜解釋高估值，如今這項理由已不再充分。
然而，這並不意味投資人應該立即清空股票。估值指標向來不擅長預測市場短期走勢，巴菲特指標多年前突破網路泡沫高點後，美股也未立刻崩盤。
伯克夏海瑟威的投資布局透露出較為謹慎的訊號。該公司仍在買進部分股票，但速度放慢、選股更加挑剔，資產負債表上的現金部位已高達 4000 億美元。這反映股票價格偏高，未來報酬可能難以超越現金，卻不代表市場即將暴跌。
史瓦林強調，投資並非只能在全押股票與完全離場之間二選一。巴菲特指標真正發出的警告是，經歷長期上漲與估值擴張後，投資人應降低對美股未來報酬的期待，接下來的長期表現可能低於歷史平均，而非一場崩盤必然迫在眉睫。
paras_en: Warren Buffett, known as the 'god of stocks', has not predicted a stock market crash, but he has praised the 'Buffett Indicator' as the 'best single measure' of market valuation. However, this indicator has now reached a historic high, sparking concerns about overvaluation in the US stock market.

The 'Buffett Indicator' is calculated by dividing the total market capitalization of US-listed companies, represented by the Wilshire 5000 index, by the US GDP. The current ratio is approximately 230%, far exceeding the 150% level before the dot-com bubble burst, making the US stock market appear even more expensive than it was back then.

However, it has been 25 years since Buffett introduced this concept, and the market structure has undergone significant changes. The Wilshire 5000 index now comprises fewer than 4,000 stocks, and many US companies generate revenue and profits from overseas, which may distort the comparison between their market capitalization and the US economy.

Jonas Svallin, senior director of FactSet's buy-side research, has adjusted the data according to the proportion of companies' revenue generated in the US market. The revised 'Buffett Indicator' is approximately 144%, significantly lower than the original 230%; however, by historical standards, the US stock market valuation remains at a high level.

Svallin stated that the US stock market is 'undoubtedly very expensive', and with interest rates no longer at unusually low levels, this extreme valuation is even more concerning. The low-interest-rate environment could previously be used to justify high valuations, but this reason is no longer sufficient.

This does not mean that investors should immediately sell their stocks. Valuation indicators have never been good at predicting short-term market trends, and the 'Buffett Indicator' exceeded the dot-com bubble high point years ago without the market immediately crashing.

The investment layout of Berkshire Hathaway reflects a more cautious signal. The company is still buying some stocks, but at a slower pace and with more selective stock-picking, with a cash position of over $400 billion on its balance sheet. This reflects that stock prices are high and future returns may be difficult to exceed cash, but it does not mean the market is about to crash.

Svallin emphasized that investing is not a binary choice between being fully invested in stocks or completely exiting the market. The 'Buffett Indicator' is actually warning that after a long period of growth and valuation expansion, investors should lower their expectations for future US stock market returns, which may be lower than the historical average, rather than a crash being imminent.

items.title: 美債創歷史新高之際 貝森特藉由干預日元市場應對危機
items.title_en: US Debt Reaches Historic High as Bessent Intervenes in Yen Market to Address Crisis
paras: 最新財政數據顯示，美國國債規模已達到了前所未有的歷史巔峰，而財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 正試圖透過干預日元市場，來應對這場可能動搖全球經濟基石的危機。這項行動被分析人士視為一種策略性的「自衛」，旨在防止債務利息支出失控。

美債利息支出首度超越國防

截至 2026 年 7 月 30 日，美國財政部的會計數據顯示，國家總債務已達 39.84 兆美元。目前債務正以每天約 126 億美元的速度增長，預計在 9 月 30 日財政年度結束前，將無可避免地突破 40 兆美元大關。
更令人憂心的是債務利息的成本。國會預算辦公室 (CBO) 預計，2026 財年的淨利息支出將超過 1 兆美元，這幾乎是 2020 年水準 (3,450 億美元) 的三倍之多。在 2026 財年的前三個月，淨利息支出已達到 2,700 億美元，首度在同一時間窗口內超越了國防開支。
目前，公眾持有的債務已超過 31.3 兆美元，CBO 預測這比例將從目前的 GDP 101% 上升至 2036 年的 120%，打破二戰後的紀錄。

貝森特的「自衛」策略

在美債危機深化的背景下，財政部長貝森特展開了一場看似「拯救他人貨幣」的行動。7 月底，日元一度跌至 1986 年以來的最低水準。隨後，美日展開了十多年來首次的協同干預。在一次大衛營的內閣會議上，貝森特的筆記本被拍到寫著一項代辦事項：「買入日元 (JPY)50-100 億美元」。
7 月 30 日，日本政府單日花費約 8.45 兆日元 (約 528 億美元) 進行干預，這是其史上規模最大的單日行動。隨後，紐約聯邦儲備銀行代表美國財政部拋售歐元買入日元。貝森特明確表示，日元被「嚴重低估」，且美國「將毫不猶豫地參與進一步的聯合干預」。

為什麼美國要干預日元？

據《247wallst》分析，，這場干預背後的邏輯與美國自身的債務市場密切相關。日本是美國國債最大的外資持有者之一。由於日美利差巨大 (聯準會利率維持在 3.75%，而日本銀行僅為 1%)，日元面臨極大的貶值壓力。如果日元持續崩潰，日本政府將被迫大舉拋售其持有的美國國債，來籌集資金保衛本幣。
一旦日本大規模拋售美債，將直接導致美債殖利率飆升，進而推高華盛頓的借貸成本。在美債 30 年期殖利率已觸及 5.27% 的高位下，美國已無法承受更高的利率負擔。因此，貝森特買入日元，在本質上是「以其他手段進行的美債市場購買」，旨在穩定美債市場。

全球兩大債務國的命運交織

日本目前的財政狀況比美國更為嚴峻，其政府債務占 GDP 的比例高達 237%。隨著聯準會受困於居高不下的核心 PCE 數據而難以降息，美日之間的利率差短期內難以縮減，這使得日元依然脆弱並依賴干預。
接下來的金融觀察重點將是即將在北卡羅萊納州舉行的 G20 會議。外界預期貝森特將與日本銀行總裁植田和男會面。如果屆時宣布擴大「FIMA 回購設施」，這將意味著全球兩張最緊張的資產負債表將更顯著地捆綁在一起，共同應對這場史無前例的債務洪流。
paras_en: The latest financial data shows that the US national debt has reached an unprecedented historic peak, while Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is attempting to intervene in the yen market to address this crisis that could shake the foundation of the global economy. This action is seen by analysts as a strategic 'self-defense' aimed at preventing debt interest payments from getting out of control.

As of July 30, 2026, the US Treasury's accounting data shows that the national debt has reached $39.84 trillion, growing at a rate of approximately $12.6 billion per day. It is expected to inevitably break the $40 trillion mark before the end of the fiscal year on September 30.

More concerning is the cost of debt interest. The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) predicts that net interest payments for the 2026 fiscal year will exceed $1 trillion, nearly three times the 2020 level of $345 billion. In the first three months of the 2026 fiscal year, net interest payments have already reached $270 billion, surpassing defense spending for the first time in the same time window.
Currently, the public holds over $31.3 trillion in debt, and the CBO forecasts this ratio will rise from the current 101% of GDP to 120% by 2036, breaking the post-World War II record.

In the face of the deepening US debt crisis, Treasury Secretary Bessent has launched an action that appears to be 'saving another's currency'. At the end of July, the yen once fell to its lowest level since 1986. Subsequently, the US and Japan conducted their first joint intervention in over a decade. In a Camp David cabinet meeting, Bessent's notebook was photographed with a to-do item: 'Buy JPY $5-10 billion'.

On July 30, the Japanese government spent approximately 845 billion yen (around $5.28 billion) on intervention, its largest single-day action in history. Following this, the New York Federal Reserve, representing the US Treasury, sold euros to buy yen. Bessent explicitly stated that the yen is 'severely undervalued' and that the US 'will not hesitate to participate in further joint intervention'.

According to analysis by 247wallst, the logic behind this intervention is closely related to the US's own debt market. Japan is one of the largest foreign holders of US debt. Due to the significant difference in interest rates between Japan and the US (the Federal Reserve's rate is at 3.75%, while the Bank of Japan's is at 1%), the yen faces enormous downward pressure. If the yen continues to collapse, the Japanese government will be forced to sell a large amount of US debt to raise funds to defend its currency.

Once Japan sells a large amount of US debt, it will directly lead to a surge in US bond yields, thereby increasing Washington's borrowing costs. With the 30-year US bond yield already at a high of 5.27%, the US cannot afford higher interest rates. Therefore, Bessent's purchase of yen is essentially a 'US debt market purchase in another form', aimed at stabilizing the US debt market.

The current financial situation in Japan is even more severe than in the US, with its government debt-to-GDP ratio reaching 237%. As the Federal Reserve is stuck with high core PCE data and finds it difficult to cut interest rates, the interest rate difference between the US and Japan is unlikely to narrow in the short term, leaving the yen vulnerable and reliant on intervention.

The next focus of financial observation will be the upcoming G20 meeting in North Carolina. It is expected that Bessent will meet with Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda. If an expansion of the 'FIMA repurchase facility' is announced at that time, it will mean that the two most tense asset-liability tables in the world will be more significantly tied together to address this unprecedented debt flood.

items.title: 川普取消攻擊、美伊恢復談判！道瓊期指狂飆逾500點、油價崩跌
items.title_en: Trump Calls Off Attack, US-Iran Talks to Resume! Dow Futures Soar Over 500 Points, Oil Prices Plunge
paras: 美國總統川普宣布取消原定對伊朗發動的新一波攻擊，並透露美伊兩國將恢復談判，帶動國際油價大跌、美股期指周一 (3 日) 全面走高。道瓊期指一度大漲 535 點或 1%，標普 500 指數期貨上漲 0.6%，那斯達克 100 指數期貨則漲 0.2%。
川普周日表示，他已取消原定對伊朗發動的軍事攻擊，美伊談判將於周一重新展開。美國媒體上周五才報導，隨著透過談判結束戰爭的希望逐漸消退、能源價格飆升，川普正準備對伊朗展開新一波空襲，如今局勢出現轉折，緩解市場對能源供應中斷的擔憂。
國際油價聞訊重挫，布蘭特原油期貨下跌 5.2%，報每桶 83.39 美元；西德州中級原油期貨跌幅更達 6.2%，報每桶 79.45 美元。
隨著能源價格下降稍微減輕通膨疑慮，美國公債殖利率也同步走低，指標 10 年期美債殖利率下滑 6 個基點至 4.68%。
不過，Vital Knowledge 創辦人克里沙富利 (Adam Crisafulli) 指出，投資人仍刻意壓低樂觀情緒，因為市場過去也曾經歷類似的希望升溫，這場衝突在真正獲得解決以前，可能仍有一段路要走，甚至最終能否達成協議也存在疑問。
周一是 8 月首個交易日，美股三大指數在經歷動盪的 7 月後，正試圖重新站穩腳步。投資人本周也將迎來一系列美國勞動市場數據，焦點落在周五公布的 7 月非農就業與失業率。
FactSet 調查顯示，市場預估美國 7 月非農就業人口增加 8.75 萬人，高於 6 月的 5.7 萬人；失業率則可能由 4.2% 升至 4.3%。相關數據將成為市場研判美國經濟與聯準會 (Fed) 政策前景的重要依據。
歐股周一早盤普遍走高，道瓊歐洲 600 指數上漲 0.3%，汽車類股大漲近 2.3%。德國 DAX 指數上漲 1.3%，法國 CAC 40 指數漲近 1.1%，英國富時 100 指數則小跌近 0.1%。
亞太股市漲跌互見，南韓 KOSPI 指數在上周五創下歷來最佳單日表現後回跌逾 5%；日本日經 225 指數下跌 0.94%，中國滬深 300 指數跌 0.98%，澳洲 S&P/ASX 200 指數則上漲 0.47%。
paras_en: US President Trump announced the cancellation of a new wave of attacks on Iran and revealed that the US and Iran would resume negotiations, driving international oil prices down and boosting US stock futures on Monday. Dow futures surged 535 points or 1%, the S&P 500 index futures rose 0.6%, and the Nasdaq 100 index futures gained 0.2%.

Trump stated on Sunday that he had canceled the planned military attack on Iran, and US-Iran talks would resume on Monday. US media reported on Friday that with hopes of ending the war through negotiations fading and energy prices soaring, Trump was preparing for a new wave of airstrikes, but the situation has now taken a turn, easing market concerns about energy supply disruptions.
International oil prices plummeted in response, with Brent crude futures falling 5.2% to $83.39 per barrel and West Texas Intermediate crude futures dropping 6.2% to $79.45 per barrel.
As energy prices decreased, easing inflation concerns, US Treasury yields also fell, with the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield slipping 6 basis points to 4.68%.

However, Vital Knowledge founder Adam Crisafulli noted that investors are intentionally tempering their optimism, as the market has experienced similar hopes before, and this conflict may still have a long way to go before it is truly resolved, with doubts remaining about whether an agreement can be reached.

Monday marked the first trading day of August, and US stocks are trying to regain their footing after a turbulent July. Investors will also face a series of US labor market data this week, with a focus on the July non-farm payroll and unemployment rate to be released on Friday.

According to a FactSet survey, the market expects the US non-farm payroll to increase by 87,500 in July, higher than the 57,000 in June, while the unemployment rate may rise from 4.2% to 4.3%. The data will be a key indicator for the market to assess the US economy and the Federal Reserve's policy outlook.

European stocks rose broadly on Monday, with the Stoxx Europe 600 index up 0.3% and the automotive sector surging nearly 2.3%. The German DAX index gained 1.3%, the French CAC 40 index rose nearly 1.1%, and the UK's FTSE 100 index fell slightly by 0.1%.

Asian-Pacific stocks were mixed, with South Korea's KOSPI index retreating over 5% after its best single-day performance on record last Friday; Japan's Nikkei 225 index fell 0.94%, China's Shanghai Composite index dropped 0.98%, and Australia's S&P/ASX 200 index rose 0.47%.

items.title: 市場別押錯方向！Fed三把手警告：必要時毫不猶豫升息
items.title_en: Market Misjudges Direction! Fed Warns: Will Raise Rates Without Hesitation If Necessary
paras: 紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯 (John Williams) 表示，他仍樂觀看待美國通膨將逐步降溫，但若物價壓力未能朝 2% 目標回落，聯準會 (Fed) 將毫不猶豫採取行動，包括進一步升息。
威廉斯上周五接受《路透》專訪時指出，如果能源價格與關稅影響已經觸頂，且美國經濟維持穩健，過去一年半推升通膨的部分主要因素可望逐漸淡化，先前受到壓抑的通膨降溫力量也可能重新浮現。
他預期，美國通膨將在今年下半年下降，明年進一步放緩，並於 2028 年以前持續回到 Fed 設定的 2% 目標。不過，他目前最關注的是未來幾個月核心通膨數據，觀察物價漲勢是否確實進入符合 2% 目標的下降軌道。
威廉斯重申，現行利率水準「處於適當位置」，足以引導通膨逐步回落。但他也強調，如果經濟發展方向無法讓通膨降至 2%，Fed 採取行動、重新將物價拉回正軌將是完全適當的選擇。
Fed 上周召開聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 會議，以 9 票對 3 票決定將聯邦基金利率目標區間維持在 3.50% 至 3.75%。威廉斯表示，他強烈支持按兵不動的決定。
通膨已經超過五年未回到 2% 或以下。Fed 偏好的通膨指標 6 月年增 3.7%，除受到美伊戰爭、能源供應衝擊與川普政府關稅影響外，企業大舉投資人工智慧 (AI) 帶來的需求，也使物價承受額外壓力。
三名 Fed 官員在上周會議投下反對票，並於周五發布聲明，主張提高短期借貸成本以壓低通膨。克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克表示，通膨已連續超過五年頑固維持在 2% 以上，她沒有信心物價漲勢能自行回到政策目標。
市場也開始反映 Fed 可能再次升息。由於投資人擔憂通膨將長期居高不下，美國長期公債殖利率持續攀升，利率期貨則顯示，交易員認為 Fed 在今年底以前升息的機率已不可忽視。

不受市場定價綁架 關注能源衝擊變化

威廉斯坦言，當前經濟前景仍存在高度不確定性，中東衝突再起，也讓能源價格何時回落變得難以判斷。不過，一旦衝突獲得解決、航運恢復正常，能源市場改善速度可能相當快。
他目前的基準預測是，中東衝突不至於在今年下半年或明年持續推升通膨，但實際情況仍可能隨戰事發展改變。
面對金融市場押注 Fed 年底前可能升息，威廉斯強調，Fed「絕對不會」受到市場價格綁架。決策官員雖然密切觀察金融市場，仍須進行獨立分析，綜合評估影響經濟與前景的各項因素，再作出貨幣政策決定。
新任 Fed 主席華許已減少提供貨幣政策的「前瞻指引」，市場因而更難預測 Fed 下一步動向，也增加經濟數據與官員談話引發價格波動的可能性。

看好 AI 長期前景 暫不憂心金融風險

談到 AI 熱潮，威廉斯仍對產業前景抱持樂觀態度，並認為近期 AI 類股與相關資產價格劇烈波動並不令人意外。在技術快速創新、產業環境迅速變化的時期，市場出現大幅度漲跌相當常見，過去科技浪潮期間也曾發生類似情況。
至於企業為了擴建 AI 基礎設施大舉借款，是否可能形成金融穩定風險，威廉斯認為，目前槓桿程度與約二十年前引爆金融危機的情況不同。
他指出，多數投入 AI 領域的企業擁有相當高的獲利，現階段尚未因相關借貸與槓桿擴張而感到特別憂慮。不過，Fed 仍將持續觀察 AI 投資、資產價格波動與企業融資對整體經濟帶來的影響。
paras_en: New York Federal Reserve Bank President John Williams stated that he remains optimistic about the US inflation rate gradually cooling down, but if price pressures do not fall back to the 2% target, the Federal Reserve (Fed) will take action without hesitation, including further rate hikes.

Williams pointed out in an interview with Reuters last Friday that if energy prices and tariff impacts have peaked and the US economy remains robust, the main factors that drove inflation over the past year and a half may gradually fade, and the previously suppressed inflation-cooling forces may re-emerge.

He expects US inflation to decline in the second half of this year, slow further next year, and continue to return to the Fed's 2% target before 2028. However, he is currently most concerned about the core inflation data for the next few months, observing whether the price increase trend is indeed on a downward trajectory that meets the 2% target.

Williams reiterated that the current interest rate level is 'at an appropriate position' to guide inflation down gradually. However, he also emphasized that if the economic development direction cannot bring inflation down to 2%, the Fed taking action to pull prices back on track would be a completely appropriate choice.

The Fed decided to maintain the federal funds target rate range at 3.50% to 3.75% with a 9-3 vote at the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting last week. Williams stated that he strongly supported the decision to hold steady.

Inflation has not returned to 2% or below for over five years. The Fed's preferred inflation indicator rose 3.7% year-over-year in June, with additional pressure from companies' large investments in artificial intelligence (AI) driving demand, aside from the impacts of the US-Iran war, energy supply shocks, and Trump administration tariffs.

Three Fed officials cast dissenting votes at the meeting last week and released a statement on Friday, advocating for higher short-term borrowing costs to curb inflation. Cleveland Federal Reserve Bank President Loretta Mester stated that she has no confidence that price pressures will return to the policy target on their own, given that inflation has remained above 2% for over five years.

The market has begun to reflect the possibility of the Fed raising rates again. Due to concerns that inflation will remain high for an extended period, long-term US Treasury yields have continued to rise, and interest rate futures indicate that traders believe the likelihood of the Fed raising rates before the end of the year is not negligible.

Williams frankly stated that the current economic outlook still has high uncertainty, and the resurgence of conflict in the Middle East has made it difficult to predict when energy prices will fall. However, once the conflict is resolved and shipping returns to normal, the energy market may improve quickly.

His current baseline forecast is that the Middle East conflict will not continue to drive inflation up in the second half of this year or next year, but the actual situation may still change with the development of the conflict.

In the face of financial markets betting on the Fed possibly raising rates before the end of the year, Williams emphasized that the Fed 'absolutely will not' be bound by market prices. While policymakers closely observe financial markets, they must conduct independent analysis and comprehensively evaluate the various factors affecting the economy and outlook before making monetary policy decisions.

New Fed Chairman Jeffery Walker has reduced the provision of forward guidance on monetary policy, making it more difficult for the market to predict the Fed's next move and increasing the likelihood that economic data and officials' comments will trigger price fluctuations.

Regarding the AI boom, Williams remains optimistic about the industry's prospects and believes that the recent sharp fluctuations in AI-related stocks and assets are not unexpected. In periods of rapid technological innovation and rapid changes in the industry environment, significant fluctuations in the market are quite common, and similar situations have occurred during past technology waves.

As for whether companies' large-scale borrowing to expand AI infrastructure may pose financial stability risks, Williams believes that the current leverage is different from the situation that triggered the financial crisis about twenty years ago.

He pointed out that most companies investing in AI have relatively high profits, and at this stage, he is not particularly concerned about the related borrowing and leverage expansion. However, the Fed will continue to monitor the impact of AI investment, asset price fluctuations, and corporate financing on the overall economy.

items.title: 別被財報誤導！多頭大咖也示警：AI資本支出恐見頂 兩大危險訊號浮現
items.title_en: Don't Be Misled by Earnings! Bullish Big‑Name Warns AI Capital Expenditure May Have Peaked, Two Major Risk Signals Emerge
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮持續推升全球資本市場，科技巨頭更承諾投入數千億美元擴大布局。然而，隨著資本支出加速，長期看多市場的 Leuthold Group 首席投資策略師 Jim Paulsen 卻發出警告，認為 AI 支出浪潮可能即將降溫，市場未來恐面臨兩大隱憂與更大波動。
儘管市場仍在高度關注財報表現，根據最新發布的第二季數據，包含 Meta(META-US) 、微軟 (MSFT-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 在內的「四大科技巨頭」，年中給出的開支指引較年初進一步上修，預計 2026 年合計資本支出上限將衝向 7,500 億美元的歷史新高，相較於去年的 4,558 億美元呈現大幅增長。
然而，Jim Paulsen 認為，市場的隱憂已逐漸浮現。他首先提到，AI 相關股票近期的疲軟表現是一個顯著的警訊，顯示投資人已開始為支出成長放緩做好心理準備。
事實上，Alphabet、特斯拉與 Meta 等公司在近期財報公布後股價遭遇重挫，反映出投資者對於這些巨額資本支出能否獲得相應回報，已抱持著日益謹慎的態度。
此外，Paulsen 所捕捉到的第二個市場趨勢，是美國核心資本貨物訂單的急劇下降。
他分析指出，隨著油價、債券殖利率與美元匯率的震盪，市場實際上已將資本支出放緩的預期納入定價。
他強調，倘若未來 6 個月內美國的核心資本支出出現停滯甚至下滑，將迫使許多過度樂觀的投資者被迫重新調整心態，這恐將引發市場情緒的重大波動。
市場對於 AI 支出放緩的疑慮不僅限於 Paulsen 一人。早在 7 月初，瑞銀（UBS）便曾發布預測指出，超大規模雲端服務商的資本支出成長，將在 3 年內出現「急煞車」。
瑞銀預估，雖然今年的支出增速仍處於高檔，但明年的成長幅度將顯著放緩至 25%，至 2028 年更可能降至僅 6%。
對於這波可能驟然消退的「AI 投資巨浪」，市場空頭專家艾斯曼（Steve Eisman）給出了嚴厲的警告。他認為，目前的市場環境已淪為高度依賴 AI 發展的單一交易模式，一旦任何一家超大規模科技巨頭選擇削減支出，美國股市恐怕將面臨「直線下跌」的嚴重後果。
隨著投資者從狂熱回歸理性審視，人工智慧資本支出的持續性，無疑將成為決定未來市場走勢的關鍵變數。
paras_en: The AI investment frenzy continues to lift global capital markets, with tech giants pledging to pour hundreds of billions of dollars into expanding their AI footprint. Yet, as capital spending accelerates, Jim Paulsen, chief investment strategist at the long‑biased Leuthold Group, warns that the AI spending wave could be cooling, exposing the market to two looming risks and heightened volatility.

Despite the market’s focus on earnings, the latest Q2 data show that the "Big Four" tech companies—Meta (META‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US)—have raised their mid‑year spending guidance from the start‑of‑year outlook. They now project total capital expenditures by 2026 to hit a historic high of $750 billion, up sharply from $455.8 billion last year.

Paulsen says the market’s hidden concerns are already surfacing. He points to the recent weakness in AI‑related stocks as a clear warning sign that investors are beginning to brace for slower spending growth.
Indeed, after recent earnings releases, shares of Alphabet, Tesla and Meta slumped, reflecting investors’ growing caution about whether such massive capex can deliver commensurate returns.

The second trend Paulsen highlights is a sharp decline in U.S. core capital goods orders. He notes that with oil prices, bond yields and the dollar fluctuating, the market has already priced in expectations of slower capex.

He stresses that if core capital spending in the U.S. stalls or falls over the next six months, many overly optimistic investors will be forced to reassess, likely triggering a major swing in market sentiment.

Concerns about a slowdown in AI spending are not limited to Paulsen. In early July, UBS forecast that capital‑expenditure growth for ultra‑large cloud providers will hit an "emergency brake" within three years.
UBS projects that while this year’s spending growth remains high, next year’s growth will slow markedly to 25%, and could drop to just 6% by 2028.

Short‑seller Steve Eisman delivers a stark warning about the potential abrupt retreat of the "AI investment tsunami." He argues the market has become overly dependent on a single AI‑driven trade narrative, and if any ultra‑large tech giant cuts its spend, the U.S. stock market could experience a "straight‑line plunge."
As investors shift from hype to a more rational assessment, the sustainability of AI‑related capital spending will undoubtedly be a key determinant of future market direction.

items.title: 北流攜手日月光 媒合紙鳶登上泰國大型音樂節
items.title_en: Beiliu Partners with Sun Moon Light to Match Paper Kite for Thailand's Major Music Festival
paras: 曾參與臺北流行音樂中心攜手日月光文教基金會推動的「Open Lab 人才培育計畫」的樂團「紙鳶 Seizer」，日前在北流媒合下登上泰國指標性音樂節 Monster Music Festival，成為本屆唯一受邀演出的海外團體，也是樂團首次站上大型國際音樂節舞台。透過北流持續推動的人才培育與國際交流計畫，紙鳶 Seizer 成功將音樂帶向海外，也迎來成團以來最高規格的舞台製作體驗。
此次演出，主辦單位安排專屬的鼓推台、Live 即時大螢幕等大型音樂節規格，皆是紙鳶 Seizer 團員過去未曾體驗過的配置。第一次在大型螢幕同步看見自己的演出畫面，團員靦腆笑說：「第一次在有現場螢幕同步播放 Live 畫面的舞台演出，而且鏡頭一直近拍追焦我們的臉部表情，不知道剛剛自己長得怎麼樣，有點害羞。」

甜軟音樂氛圍中的獨特辣味！紙鳶重型搖滾跨越語言震撼泰國聽眾

首次站上海外音樂節，紙鳶 Seizer 特別編排最能代表樂團風格的歌單，希望在短短 40 分鐘內，讓第一次接觸他們的海外觀眾留下深刻印象。有別於現場多數偏向流行、抒情曲風的演出，紙鳶 Seizer 以充滿爆發力的重型搖滾登場，成為音樂節中最鮮明的存在。團員笑說：「我們比較像 Monster Music Festival 的調味劑，在又甜又軟的氛圍裡加一點辣！」
面對台下數百位泰國樂迷，雖然彼此語言不同，紙鳶 Seizer 仍憑藉紮實的現場演奏、緊湊流暢的編曲與高張力的舞台魅力，成功跨越語言隔閡，讓觀眾隨著音樂搖擺、歡呼，也迅速與現場建立連結。此外，現場還有數位來自臺灣的紙鳶 Seizer 粉絲特地到場支持，讓團員倍感驚喜與溫暖。

觀摩海外音樂人被秒圈粉！巧遇 Full Step 吉他手成功合照　貝斯手亨利喊話：「要好好學英文！」

除了登上大型舞台演出，紙鳶 Seizer 也把握難得機會觀摩音樂節各大舞台演出，從樂團、創作歌手到偶像團體幾乎看遍一輪，近距離感受泰國音樂市場的多元樣貌。
團員也分享了後台的「驚喜追星體驗」，對泰國音樂人 HYE、樂團 Full Step 的現場演出留下深刻印象，甚至幸運巧遇 Full Step 吉他手並成功合照。主唱仁杰興奮表示：「Full Step 的風格非常有魅力，真的很想跟他們交朋友！」貝斯手亨利則笑說：「我要好好學英文，才能跟更多國際音樂人深度交流！」

從 Open Lab 到國際舞台　紙鳶：「謝謝音樂路上有北流和日月光撐腰！」

回顧一路從參與北流「Open Lab」到站上國際音樂節舞台，紙鳶 Seizer 坦言，樂團成立初期大家都還只是學生，無論是演奏技巧、音色掌握、器材運用或舞台魅力，都在這兩年間透過一次次演出持續累積與成長。
貝斯手亨利分享，兩年前參與 Open Lab 時，因為還是學生，站上舞台難免比較拘謹；經過兩年的現場演出歷練，這次海外演出明顯更能自在享受舞台。不過，團員也一致謙虛表示，仍有許多值得學習與突破的地方，希望持續精進創作與現場實力。
日月光文教基金會董事長吳田玉表示：「今年很榮幸與北流共同推動『Open Lab 人才培育計畫』。看見紙鳶從學生樂團起步，經實戰累積後成功登上泰國指標音樂節，我們深感欣慰。作為新生代音樂人的支持夥伴，基金會期許持續擔任創作者的堅實後盾，陪伴更多臺灣新聲代逐漸成長蛻變，在國際舞台綻放光芒。」
談到 Open Lab 帶來的收穫，紙鳶 Seizer 認為，計畫提供的不只是正式演出的機會，更讓創作者從演出規劃、排練到正式登台，完整理解一場演出的製作流程，也累積與產業接軌的實戰經驗。他們也鼓勵剛踏入音樂產業的新秀：「如果有機會，我們真的很推薦大家來嘗試。」
談起一路走來最想感謝的人，紙鳶 Seizer 將這次海外演出的收穫獻給一路陪伴他們成長的臺北流行音樂中心，感性表示：「沒有北流，就不會有紙鳶。我們永遠飲水思源，謝謝音樂路上有北流撐腰。」
完成 Monster Music Festival 演出後，紙鳶 Seizer 也將迎接下一個里程碑，第二張專輯《缺頁的名冊》即將發行，並將於 10 月 25 日在北流 SUB 舉辦發片專場，期盼將這次站上國際舞台累積的經驗與能量，轉化為下一階段的創作與現場演出，持續讓更多人聽見台灣新生代樂團的聲音。
paras_en: The band "Paper Kite Seizer," which previously participated in the "Open Lab Talent Development Program" jointly promoted by the Taipei Pop Music Center and the Sun Moon Light Cultural and Educational Foundation, recently, through Beiliu's matchmaking, performed at Thailand's flagship Monster Music Festival, becoming the only overseas group invited to perform this year and marking the band's first appearance on a large international festival stage. Through Beiliu's ongoing talent cultivation and international exchange initiatives, Paper Kite Seizer successfully took their music abroad and experienced the most elaborate stage production they have had since forming.

For this performance, the organizers provided festival‑level facilities such as a dedicated drum riser and a live‑feed big screen—equipment the band had never used before. Seeing themselves on a large screen for the first time, the members shyly laughed, "It's our first time performing on a stage with a live screen, and the camera kept close‑up focusing on our faces. I don't know how I looked just now, it's a bit embarrassing."
A unique spicy flavor in a sweet‑soft musical atmosphere! Paper Kite's heavy rock crossed language barriers to shock Thai listeners

Making their debut at an overseas festival, Paper Kite Seizer specially arranged a setlist that best represents their style, hoping to leave a strong impression on the foreign audience within a 40‑minute slot. Unlike most of the other acts, which leaned toward pop and ballads, Paper Kite Seizer took the stage with explosive heavy‑rock, becoming the most distinctive presence at the festival. A band member joked, "We’re like the seasoning for Monster Music Festival, adding a bit of spice to the sweet‑soft vibe!"

Facing several hundred Thai fans, despite the language difference, Paper Kite Seizer relied on solid live performance, tight and fluid arrangements, and high‑energy stage presence to bridge the gap, getting the audience to sway, cheer, and quickly connect with the show. In addition, a few Taiwanese fans of Paper Kite Seizer attended in person, surprising and warming the band members.
Observing overseas musicians and instantly becoming fans! A lucky encounter with Full Step’s guitarist led to a photo, and bassist Henry shouted, "I need to study English well!"

Besides performing on the big stage, Paper Kite Seizer also took the rare chance to watch other festival acts, seeing almost every type of performer—from bands and singer‑songwriters to idol groups—and getting a close‑up feel for the diversity of Thailand's music market.

The members also shared a "surprise star‑chasing experience" backstage, noting strong impressions of Thai musician HYE and the band Full Step, and even managed to meet Full Step’s guitarist for a photo. Lead vocalist Renjie excitedly said, "Full Step’s style is very charismatic; we really want to be friends with them!" Bassist Henry laughed, "I have to learn English well so I can have deeper exchanges with more international musicians!"
From Open Lab to the international stage, Paper Kite says, "Thank you to Beiliu and Sun Moon Light for supporting us on our musical journey!"

Looking back from participating in Beiliu’s "Open Lab" to standing on an international festival stage, Paper Kite Seizer admits that when the band first formed they were all students, and over the past two years they have continuously accumulated and grown in performance technique, tone control, equipment handling, and stage charisma through repeated gigs.

Bassist Henry shared that two years ago, when they joined Open Lab as students, they were naturally more restrained on stage; after two years of live‑performance experience, this overseas show felt noticeably more relaxed and enjoyable. Nevertheless, the members humbly acknowledge there is still much to learn and improve, hoping to keep refining their songwriting and live skills.

Sun Moon Light Cultural and Educational Foundation chairman Wu Tianyu said, "We are honored this year to co‑promote the 'Open Lab Talent Development Program' with Beiliu. Seeing Paper Kite grow from a student band to successfully performing at Thailand’s flagship festival fills us with pride. As a partner supporting the new generation of musicians, the foundation aims to remain a solid backing for creators, accompanying more Taiwanese new voices as they evolve and shine on the international stage."

Regarding the benefits of Open Lab, Paper Kite Seizer believes the program offers more than performance opportunities; it lets creators understand the full production process—from planning and rehearsals to the actual stage—while gaining practical experience that connects them with the industry. They encourage newcomers to the music business, saying, "If you have the chance, we highly recommend you give it a try."

When asked who they are most grateful to, Paper Kite Seizer dedicates this overseas achievement to the Taipei Pop Music Center, expressing emotionally, "Without Beiliu, Paper Kite wouldn’t exist. We will always remember our roots and thank Beiliu for supporting us on our musical path."

After completing their Monster Music Festival set, Paper Kite Seizer looks forward to the next milestone: their second album, "The Missing Page Register," is slated for release, and they will hold a launch concert on October 25 at Beiliu’s SUB. They hope to transform the experience and energy gained from the international stage into new creations and live performances, continuing to let more people hear the voice of Taiwan’s new‑generation bands.

items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Higher as U.S.-Iran Tensions Ease and Oil Falls Below $80
paras: 美股主要指數周一 (3 日) 開高，美國總統川普取消原定對伊朗發動的攻擊，中東緊張局勢出現降溫希望，帶動國際油價重挫、西德州原油跌破每桶 80 美元，緩解市場對能源價格推升通膨的擔憂。
風險偏好回升，加上企業財報表現穩健，道瓊指數早盤一度大漲逾 600 點，美國公債同步走高、殖利率下滑。投資人本周也將迎來密集的企業財報與重要經濟數據。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近 600 點或 1.1%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近 220 點或 近 0.9%，標普 500 指數漲 0.7%，費城半導體指數跌 2.9%。台積電 ADR 跌近 0.8%。
美伊緊張局勢出現降溫跡象，國際油價周一一度暴跌逾 7%，緩解市場對能源成本推升通膨、迫使利率長期維持高檔的擔憂，帶動美股期指與美國公債同步上漲。
標普 500 指數期貨上漲 0.5%，為本周美股開出紅盤增添希望。美國總統川普取消原定對伊朗發動的軍事攻擊後，布蘭特原油期貨一度重挫 7.3%，跌至每桶 81.55 美元。
美債殖利率全面下降，指標 10 年期美債殖利率下滑 6 個基點至 4.68%，脫離今年 1 月以來最高水準。彭博美元指數則下跌 0.1%。
IG 駐巴黎首席市場分析師 Alexandre Baradez 表示，地緣政治消息帶動油價下降，也減輕債券殖利率的上行壓力。不過，美債殖利率、金融槓桿與聯準會 (Fed) 政策仍存在問題，在這些不確定性消除前，還不能斷言股市已完全擺脫風險。

荷姆茲海峽協商傳進展 市場等待和平協議

伊朗周一透露，讓船舶恢復通行荷姆茲海峽的談判正取得進展。川普先前也表示，在取消攻擊伊朗後，美伊兩國將恢復協商。
美伊戰爭引發的供應緊縮已推高燃料成本，加深市場對新一波通膨的擔憂。AT Global Markets 首席市場分析師 Nick Twidale 表示，如果美伊達成具體和平協議，或更重要的是荷姆茲海峽重新開放，全球市場可能出現強勁的紓壓反彈。
不過，《彭博》策略師警告，原油市場仍不能將美伊衝突拋在腦後，價格風險依舊偏向上行。選擇權市場對油價上漲的擔憂仍高於下跌，顯示交易員認為供應衝擊再次推高布蘭特原油的可能性，仍大於油價持續大幅下滑。
除中東局勢外，AI 類股估值與通膨風險仍主導市場走勢。投資人本周將密切關注周五公布的美國 7 月就業報告，藉此研判 Fed 下一步政策。SpaceX 則將於周二公布上市後首份財報，歐洲企業匯豐與諾和諾德也將發布業績。
個股方面，百時美施貴寶盤前大漲逾 8%，消息傳出英國製藥大廠阿斯特捷利康曾研究收購這家公司；阿斯特捷利康在倫敦重挫逾 7%。萬豪國際因獲利展望不佳下跌 3.7%。
歐洲道瓊 600 指數上漲 0.4%，消費品與汽車類股領漲。亞洲股市則普遍走低，南韓晶片股大跌，顯示 AI 概念股的劇烈震盪尚未結束。

日元劇烈震盪 美日不排除再次聯手干預

日元周一早盤先跌後升，兌美元一度大漲 1.4%，隨後吐回大部分漲幅，倫敦盤交易於 156.90 附近。市場猜測，美日上周協調干預後，官方可能再次進場買進日元，但部分波動也可能來自緊張的交易員或演算法交易。
日本財務省證實，美日已於美國時間 7 月 31 日協調進行買進日元的操作，若有必要，不會猶豫再次聯手干預。美國財長貝森特表示，美方出手是為了遏止日元「失序」波動，未來也準備繼續協助日本，並提到日本可使用 Fed 的一項融通機制。
野村國際北亞投資長 Julia Wang 預期，未來一周日元可能繼續震盪，並出現暫時性走強；但干預措施並未改變美元兌日元的實際方向，一旦官方操作結束，美元兌日元仍可能重新走高。

paras_en: U.S. equity indexes opened higher on Monday (the 3rd) as President Trump cancelled the planned attack on Iran, raising hopes that Middle‑East tensions are cooling. The news sent international oil prices plunging, with West Texas Intermediate falling below $80 a barrel, easing market worries that energy costs could fuel inflation.

Risk appetite rebounded and corporate earnings were solid, sending the Dow Jones Industrial Average up more than 600 points in early trade, while U.S. Treasury yields fell. Investors this week also face a packed schedule of corporate earnings and key economic data.

Just before the deadline, the Dow was up about 600 points or 1.1%, the Nasdaq Composite rose roughly 220 points or about 0.9%, the S&P 500 gained 0.7%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index slipped 2.9%. Taiwan Semiconductor ADR fell about 0.8%.

Signs of a de‑escalation in U.S.–Iran tensions saw oil prices plunge more than 7% on Monday, easing concerns that energy costs would push inflation higher and force rates to stay elevated, which in turn lifted U.S. futures and Treasury bonds.

S&P 500 futures rose 0.5%, adding optimism to a week of mostly red sessions for U.S. stocks. After Trump scrapped the planned military strike on Iran, Brent crude futures tumbled 7.3% to $81.55 a barrel.
U.S. Treasury yields fell across the board, with the benchmark 10‑year yield down six basis points to 4.68%, slipping from its peak since January. Bloomberg’s dollar index slipped 0.1%.

IG’s chief market analyst in Paris, Alexandre Baradez, said geopolitical news drove oil lower and also eased upward pressure on bond yields. However, he warned that Treasury yields, financial leverage and Fed policy still pose risks, and until those uncertainties are cleared the market cannot claim to be out of danger.

Progress reported in Houthi‑controlled Strait of Hormuz talks and markets await a peace deal. Iran said on Monday that negotiations to reopen the strait were making headway, and Trump had earlier said that after canceling the attack, the U.S. and Iran would resume talks.

The war‑driven supply squeeze had lifted fuel costs and deepened worries about a new wave of inflation. AT Global Markets’ chief analyst Nick Twidale said that a concrete peace agreement—or, more importantly, the reopening of the strait—could spark a strong relief rally in global markets.

But Bloomberg strategists cautioned that the oil market cannot ignore the U.S.–Iran conflict, and price risk remains skewed higher. Options markets show more concern about oil rising than falling, indicating traders still see a higher chance of supply shocks pushing Brent up again rather than a sustained sharp decline.

Beyond the Middle East, AI‑related stock valuations and inflation risk continue to dominate market direction. Investors will watch Friday’s U.S. July jobs report closely to gauge the Fed’s next move. SpaceX will release its first post‑IPO earnings on Tuesday, and European firms HSBC and Novo Nordisk are also slated to report.

On the equity side, Bristol‑Myers Squibb jumped more than 8% pre‑market after rumors that UK drugmaker AstraZeneca had explored a takeover; AstraZeneca fell more than 7% in London. Marriott International slid 3.7% after a weak profit outlook.
Europe’s DAX 600 rose 0.4%, led by consumer and auto stocks. Asian markets were broadly lower, with South Korean chip stocks tumbling, showing that the AI‑stock volatility has not yet subsided.

The yen swung sharply on Monday, first falling then rising, spiking 1.4% against the dollar before giving back most of the gain and trading near 156.90 in the London session. Markets speculate that after coordinated intervention last week, officials may step in again, though some of the movement may stem from nervous traders or algorithmic activity.

Japan’s finance ministry confirmed that Japan and the U.S. coordinated a yen‑buying operation on July 31 (U.S. time) and would not hesitate to intervene again if needed. U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen said the action was meant to curb “disorderly” yen moves and that the U.S. stands ready to continue assisting Japan, noting Japan could tap a Fed liquidity facility.

Nomura International’s North Asia head Julia Wang expects the yen to remain volatile and possibly see a temporary bounce this week, but she says intervention has not changed the underlying dollar‑yen trend; once official action ends, the dollar could resume its rise against the yen.

As of about 21:00 Taipei time on Monday (the 3rd): Dow Jones Industrial Average up 659.95 points or 1.26% at 53,144.98; Nasdaq Composite up 95.23 points or 0.38% at 25,469.09; S&P 500 up 41.14 points or 0.55% at 7,530.86; Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 375.12 points or 3.32% at 10,935.95; Taiwan Semiconductor ADR down 1.29% to $399.08; 10‑year Treasury yield down to 4.68%; NY light crude down 6.37% to $79.28 a barrel; Brent crude down 4.94% to $83.59 a barrel; gold down 0.45% to $4,088.60 an ounce; dollar index down to 99.79.

Key stocks: AstraZeneca (AZN‑US) fell 7.62% in early trade to $156.72. The Financial Times reported AstraZeneca and Bristol‑Myers Squibb (BMY‑US) are discussing a merger, causing divergent moves – AstraZeneca down more than 4% pre‑market, Bristol‑Myers up over 5%. Alibaba (BABA‑US) rose 4.60% to $127.87 after unveiling its new AI model Qwen 3.8‑Max, one of its most powerful to date, slated for release next week. Micron (MU‑US) fell 3.79% to $791.82; memory stocks were broadly lower after last week’s volatility, with SanDisk (SNDK‑US) and Micron each down over 3% and Seagate (STX‑US) down 2.5%.
Today's key economic data: U.S. July ISM manufacturing index expected at 54.0 (previous 53.3); U.S. July manufacturing PMI final expected at 53.8 (previous 53.8).

Wall Street analysis: Morgan Stanley upgraded its rating on Korean equities from “neutral” to “outperform,” citing a recent sharp retreat of leveraged positions that creates a better entry point for AI and industrial super‑cycle themes. The firm sees the KOSPI still having about 36% upside to a 9,000‑point target, noting the recent decline was largely technical and that de‑leveraging of leveraged ETFs, hedge funds and retail margin has passed the halfway point. The KOSPI has fallen more than 30% since its June peak. Korean stocks, a key gauge of Asian AI demand, have been hit hard by rapid fund outflows, the prevalence of leveraged ETFs and concentration in index weights, amplifying the drop. Morgan Stanley projects the KOSPI could swing between 5,500 and 10,500 points in the short term, with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix providing valuation support; industrial, defense and financial stocks may also benefit from favorable fundamentals.

items.title: KKR斥資57億美元收購Integer趁估值回落布局醫療器材供應鏈
items.title_en: KKR Spends $5.7 Billion to Acquire Integer as Valuation Falls, Expanding Medical Device Supply Chain
paras: 2026年08月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 私募基金KKR宣布，將以全現金交易收購醫療器材&器械製造商Integer Holdings(ITGR-US)，交易總價約57億美元，完成後Integer將下市，成為KKR旗下非上市公司。
消息公布後，Integer盤前股價上漲近3%。根據協議，KKR將以每股127美元現金收購Integer，較8月1日收盤價溢價4.78%，交易內容亦包含承接Integer既有債務。
由於醫療器材&器械產業具有需求穩定、切入門檻高的特性。當短期市況不佳導致企業估值回落時，往往成為私募基金布局的時機。Integer近兩季因部分新產品導入速度不如預期，以及電生理（EP）產品客戶調整庫存與需求預測，下修2026年營運展望，短期逆風壓抑市場評價，也提供KKR等長線投資人趁勢布局的機會。
根據統計，目前Integer交易在18.4倍預估本益比，略低於同業公司平均的19.7倍。
Integer總部位於美國德州普萊諾（Plano），主要為全球大型醫療器材&器械廠商提供關鍵零組件與產品，應用涵蓋心臟治療、疼痛管理及其他醫療技術領域，是醫療器材供應鏈的重要廠商。
近年私募基金持續加碼醫療產業投資，包括American Industrial Partners以12.7億美元收購Avanos Medical，以及Blackstone與TPG以183億美元收購專注女性健康檢測的Hologic，都顯示醫療產業仍是併購熱門領域。
截至2026年第二季底，KKR管理資產規模達7,960億美元。此次收購是KKR自2018年以99億美元收購Envision Healthcare以來，在醫療領域規模最大的交易之一。

paras_en: On August 3, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Private‑equity firm KKR announced it will acquire medical device and equipment manufacturer Integer Holdings (ITGR‑US) in an all‑cash transaction valued at roughly $5.7 billion. After the deal closes, Integer will be delisted and become a privately held KKR subsidiary.

Following the announcement, Integer’s pre‑market share rose about 3%. Under the agreement, KKR will pay $127 in cash per share, a 4.78% premium to the closing price on August 1, and the deal also includes assuming Integer’s existing debt.

Because the medical device and equipment sector features stable demand and high entry barriers, valuation declines during short‑term market weakness often create buying opportunities for private‑equity funds. Integer trimmed its 2026 operating outlook after slower‑than‑expected roll‑out of some new products and inventory and demand adjustments by its electrophysiology (EP) customers, which dampened its short‑term market valuation and opened a window for long‑term investors such as KKR to step in.
According to the data, the Integer transaction is priced at an estimated 18.4‑times forward earnings, slightly below the industry average of 19.7 times.

Integer is headquartered in Plano, Texas, and supplies key components and products to large global medical‑device manufacturers across cardiac therapy, pain management and other medical‑technology fields, making it an important player in the medical‑device supply chain.

In recent years, private‑equity firms have continued to increase investments in the healthcare sector, including American Industrial Partners’ $1.27 billion acquisition of Avanos Medical and Blackstone and TPG’s $18.3 billion purchase of women‑health diagnostics company Hologic, underscoring the sector’s ongoing M&A appeal.

As of the end of Q2 2026, KKR’s assets under management total $796 billion. This acquisition is one of the largest healthcare deals for KKR since its $9.9 billion purchase of Envision Healthcare in 2018.

items.title: 韓國央行抄底黃金 13年來首次增持！
items.title_en: South Korea's Central Bank Resumes Gold Purchases After 13 Years
paras: 韓國央行時隔逾 13 年重啟黃金購買計畫，並同步布局黃金 ETF，象徵這家長期因政治壓力而迴避黃金的央行正式轉向，加入全球央行增持黃金浪潮。
韓國銀行宣布，將在中長期內提高黃金在外匯儲備中的比重，並引入從國內黃金供應商採購出口用黃金的新渠道。
與此同時，韓國央行還開始購買以黃金為標的的美國交易所交易基金（ETF），但 ETF 在外匯儲備統計中歸類為證券，而非黃金。
此次韓國央行重啟購金，終結了自 2013 年 2 月以來長達 13 年的空窗期。韓國銀行外匯儲備管理部門負責人 Jeong Hee-seop 表示，地緣政治風險上升帶動市場對黃金避險屬性的關注度提高，加之金價已從高檔回落，價格壓力減輕，央行判斷有必要擴大黃金持有量。
韓國銀行目前持有黃金 104.4 噸，在世界黃金協會追蹤的 100 個國家中排名第 40 名。
然而，黃金佔其外匯儲備的比例僅 3.5%，在 100 國中排名第 98 名，與韓國外匯儲備規模全球第 13 名的地位嚴重不符。
韓國銀行此次轉向，契合全球央行加速增持黃金的大背景。在美國金融制裁風險上升的背景下，各國央行正透過擴大黃金儲備降低對美元資產的依賴。
世界黃金協會的數據顯示，2024 年至今年 7 月底，波蘭央行購金量居全球首位，達 255.2 噸，其次為中國（96.1 噸）。
截至上月，全球黃金儲備最多的國家依次為美國（8,134 噸）、德國（3,350 噸）、義大利（2,452 噸）和法國（2,437 噸）；正在削減美債持倉的中國和俄羅斯，分別以 2,332 噸和 2,292 噸位列第五和第六。
世界黃金協會上月發布的一項針對 74 家央行的調查顯示，45%（33 個國家）計劃在一年內增加黃金儲備，60 個國家預估未來五年黃金持有量將持續增長。
paras_en: The Bank of Korea has restarted its gold buying program after a 13-year hiatus, and is also investing in gold ETFs, marking a significant shift for the central bank, which has long avoided gold due to political pressure, and is now joining the global trend of central banks increasing their gold reserves.

The Bank of Korea announced that it will increase the proportion of gold in its foreign exchange reserves over the medium to long term, and will introduce a new channel to purchase gold from domestic suppliers for export purposes.
At the same time, the central bank has begun buying gold ETFs, which are classified as securities rather than gold in foreign exchange reserve statistics.

This move by the Bank of Korea ends a 13-year period of inactivity in gold purchases, which had lasted since February 2013. According to Jeong Hee-seop, head of the bank's foreign exchange reserve management department, the rise in geopolitical risks has increased market attention to gold's safe-haven attributes, and with gold prices having fallen from their highs, the central bank has deemed it necessary to expand its gold holdings.

The Bank of Korea currently holds 104.4 tons of gold, ranking 40th among 100 countries tracked by the World Gold Council. However, the proportion of gold in its foreign exchange reserves is only 3.5%, ranking 98th among the 100 countries, which is severely out of line with its position as the 13th largest foreign exchange reserve holder globally.

The Bank of Korea's shift is in line with the global trend of central banks accelerating their gold purchases. In the face of rising risks of US financial sanctions, central banks are reducing their dependence on dollar assets by increasing their gold reserves.

According to data from the World Gold Council, from 2024 to the end of July this year, the Polish central bank was the largest buyer of gold, with 255.2 tons, followed by China with 96.1 tons. As of last month, the countries with the largest gold reserves were the US (8,134 tons), Germany (3,350 tons), Italy (2,452 tons), and France (2,437 tons), while China and Russia, which are reducing their US bond holdings, ranked fifth and sixth with 2,332 tons and 2,292 tons, respectively.

A survey of 74 central banks by the World Gold Council last month found that 45% (33 countries) plan to increase their gold reserves within the next year, and 60 countries expect their gold holdings to continue to grow over the next five years.

items.title: 「巴菲特指標」衝破230%狂閃紅燈 美股真的要崩盤了嗎？
items.title_en: The 'Buffett Indicator' Surges Past 230%, But Does This Mean a Stock Market Crash is Imminent?
paras: 有「股神」之稱的巴菲特 (Warren Buffett) 並未預測美股即將崩盤，但他曾盛讚為「衡量市場估值水準的最佳單一指標」，如今卻升至歷史新高，引發市場對美股估值過熱的疑慮。
所謂「巴菲特指標」，是以威爾夏 5000 指數 (Wilshire 5000) 代表美國上市公司總市值，再除以美國國內生產毛額(GDP)。目前這項比率約達 230%，遠高於網路泡沫破裂前約 150% 的水準，表面看來，美股甚至比當年更加昂貴。
不過，巴菲特提出這項看法至今已經 25 年，市場結構也出現重大變化。威爾夏 5000 指數目前成分股早已不到 5000 家，甚至低於 4000 家；更重要的是，美國大型企業日益國際化，許多公司的營收與獲利來自海外，單純拿全球化企業的市值與美國國內經濟規模相比，可能產生失真。
FactSet 買方研究資深總監史瓦林 (Jonas Svallin) 因此依照企業在美國市場的營收占比調整數據。修正後的巴菲特指標僅約 144%，明顯低於原始版本的 230%；壞消息是，以歷史標準來看，美股估值仍處於相同程度的高檔。
史瓦林表示，美股目前「毫無疑問非常昂貴」，而且在利率不再處於異常低檔的情況下，這次估值極端化在某些方面甚至更加令人擔憂。低利率時期可以用資金成本便宜解釋高估值，如今這項理由已不再充分。
然而，這並不意味投資人應該立即清空股票。估值指標向來不擅長預測市場短期走勢，巴菲特指標多年前突破網路泡沫高點後，美股也未立刻崩盤。
伯克夏海瑟威的投資布局透露出較為謹慎的訊號。該公司仍在買進部分股票，但速度放慢、選股更加挑剔，資產負債表上的現金部位已高達 4000 億美元。這反映股票價格偏高，未來報酬可能難以超越現金，卻不代表市場即將暴跌。
史瓦林強調，投資並非只能在全押股票與完全離場之間二選一。巴菲特指標真正發出的警告是，經歷長期上漲與估值擴張後，投資人應降低對美股未來報酬的期待，接下來的長期表現可能低於歷史平均，而非一場崩盤必然迫在眉睫。
paras_en: Warren Buffett, known as the 'god of stocks', has not predicted a stock market crash, but he has praised the 'Buffett Indicator' as the 'best single measure' of market valuation. However, this indicator has now reached a historic high, sparking concerns about overvaluation in the US stock market.

The 'Buffett Indicator' is calculated by dividing the total market capitalization of US-listed companies, represented by the Wilshire 5000 index, by the US GDP. The current ratio is approximately 230%, far exceeding the 150% level before the dot-com bubble burst, making the US stock market appear even more expensive than it was back then.

However, it has been 25 years since Buffett introduced this concept, and the market structure has undergone significant changes. The Wilshire 5000 index now comprises fewer than 4,000 stocks, and many US companies generate revenue and profits from overseas, which may distort the comparison between their market capitalization and the US economy.

Jonas Svallin, senior director of FactSet's buy-side research, has adjusted the data according to the proportion of companies' revenue generated in the US market. The revised 'Buffett Indicator' is approximately 144%, significantly lower than the original 230%; however, by historical standards, the US stock market valuation remains at a high level.

Svallin stated that the US stock market is 'undoubtedly very expensive', and with interest rates no longer at unusually low levels, this extreme valuation is even more concerning. The low-interest-rate environment could previously be used to justify high valuations, but this reason is no longer sufficient.

This does not mean that investors should immediately sell their stocks. Valuation indicators have never been good at predicting short-term market trends, and the 'Buffett Indicator' exceeded the dot-com bubble high point years ago without the market immediately crashing.

The investment layout of Berkshire Hathaway reflects a more cautious signal. The company is still buying some stocks, but at a slower pace and with more selective stock-picking, with a cash position of over $400 billion on its balance sheet. This reflects that stock prices are high and future returns may be difficult to exceed cash, but it does not mean the market is about to crash.

Svallin emphasized that investing is not a binary choice between being fully invested in stocks or completely exiting the market. The 'Buffett Indicator' is actually warning that after a long period of growth and valuation expansion, investors should lower their expectations for future US stock market returns, which may be lower than the historical average, rather than a crash being imminent.

items.title: 7月半導體：AI需求推動全球漲價潮 代工與記憶體同步攀升
items.title_en: July Semiconductor: AI Demand Drives Global Price Surge, Foundry and Memory Synchronize Uptrend
paras: 7 月全球半導體市場在人工智慧 (AI) 強勁需求的推動下，展現出強大的增長動能，全球銷售額創下歷史新高。根據美國半導體行業協會 (SIA) 數據，2026 年 5 月全球半導體銷售額已首次突破 1200 億美元，年率大幅增長 104.1%。
同時，面對原材料、設備及電力成本的不斷攀升，晶圓代工大廠紛紛啟動新一輪漲價計畫。台積電已就 2027 年初的全面調價與客戶展開協商，先進製程與成熟製程的基礎漲幅預計在 5% 至 10% 之間。針對高性能計算 (HPC) 晶片的追加訂單，更可能加收 10% 至 15% 的溢價，部分訂單整體漲幅恐高達 25%。
三星電子則針對 4 奈米、5 奈米及車規 8 奈米等熱門製程，對新客戶調升報價約 15%。力積電在 7 月也展現強勢定價權，大幅上調 DRAM 代工加工費達 45%，並同步調升邏輯代工價格 10% 至 15%。力積電預期，這波漲價效益將在 11 月至 12 月反映於毛利率與營收，帶動業績階梯式成長。

記憶體量價齊升但漲幅邊際收斂 

記憶體產業已連續三個季度呈現漲價態勢，多項指標刷新歷史紀錄。根據機構預測，2026 年第三季 DRAM 合約價預計季增 13% 至 18%，但受消費端需求走弱影響，漲幅已有所收斂。
NAND Flash 方面，受 AI 推理與資料中心支撐，Q3 合約價預估季增 10% 至 15%。值得關注的是，由於產能受排擠，SLC NAND 供需缺口擴大，下半年價格可能出現翻倍式 (120% 至 170%) 的上漲。

手機與終端設備成本看漲 

半導體上游成本壓力正快速向下游傳導。高通 (Qualcomm) 已宣布 9 月起全線晶片調漲兩位數百分比，聯發科也有相關調價計畫。業界預測，這將直接推升下半年 Android 旗艦手機的售價。

企業布局與政策風向 

為應對長期需求，台積電大幅上調 2026 年資本支出至 600 億至 640 億美元，並持續擴大亞利桑那州投資。美光科技也計畫在 2035 年前將美國本土投資總額增至 2500 億美元。
政策面上，美國對 DRAM 裝置啟動的 337 調查，以及長鑫科技在科創板的高調上市，均為未來供應鏈增添了變數與競爭壓力。
paras_en: In July, the global semiconductor market showed strong growth momentum driven by robust demand for artificial intelligence (AI), with sales reaching a historic high. According to data from the US Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA), global semiconductor sales exceeded $120 billion for the first time in May 2026, with a significant year-over-year increase of 104.1%.

Facing rising costs of raw materials, equipment, and electricity, major foundries have initiated new price hikes. TSMC has begun negotiating a comprehensive price adjustment with customers for early 2027, with expected increases of 5% to 10% for advanced and mature processes. For high-performance computing (HPC) chips, additional orders may incur a premium of 10% to 15%, with some orders potentially seeing overall price increases of up to 25%.

Samsung Electronics has raised prices by around 15% for new customers on popular processes such as 4nm, 5nm, and automotive 8nm. Powerchip also demonstrated strong pricing power in July, significantly increasing DRAM processing fees by 45% and synchronously raising logic foundry prices by 10% to 15%. Powerchip expects the benefits of this price hike to be reflected in its gross margin and revenue in November and December, driving a step-by-step increase in performance.

The memory industry has seen price increases for three consecutive quarters, with multiple indicators reaching historic records. According to institutional forecasts, DRAM contract prices are expected to increase by 13% to 18% in the third quarter of 2026, but the growth rate has slowed due to weak demand from the consumer side.

In terms of NAND Flash, supported by AI inference and data centers, Q3 contract prices are expected to increase by 10% to 15%. Notably, due to production capacity constraints, the supply gap for SLC NAND is widening, and prices may see a doubling (120% to 170%) increase in the second half of the year.

The cost of upstream semiconductors is being rapidly passed on to downstream devices. Qualcomm has announced a double-digit percentage price increase for all chips starting in September, and MediaTek also has a price adjustment plan. The industry predicts that this will directly drive up the prices of Android flagship phones in the second half of the year.

To address long-term demand, TSMC has significantly increased its 2026 capital expenditure to $60 billion to $64 billion and continues to expand its investment in Arizona. Micron Technology also plans to increase its US investment to $250 billion by 2035.

In terms of policy, the US launch of a 337 investigation into DRAM devices and the high-profile listing of Huaxin Technology on the sci-tech board have added variables and competitive pressure to the future supply chain.

items.title: 美債創歷史新高之際 貝森特藉由干預日元市場應對危機
items.title_en: US Debt Reaches Historic High as Bessent Intervenes in Yen Market to Address Crisis
paras: 最新財政數據顯示，美國國債規模已達到了前所未有的歷史巔峰，而財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 正試圖透過干預日元市場，來應對這場可能動搖全球經濟基石的危機。這項行動被分析人士視為一種策略性的「自衛」，旨在防止債務利息支出失控。

美債利息支出首度超越國防

截至 2026 年 7 月 30 日，美國財政部的會計數據顯示，國家總債務已達 39.84 兆美元。目前債務正以每天約 126 億美元的速度增長，預計在 9 月 30 日財政年度結束前，將無可避免地突破 40 兆美元大關。
更令人憂心的是債務利息的成本。國會預算辦公室 (CBO) 預計，2026 財年的淨利息支出將超過 1 兆美元，這幾乎是 2020 年水準 (3,450 億美元) 的三倍之多。在 2026 財年的前三個月，淨利息支出已達到 2,700 億美元，首度在同一時間窗口內超越了國防開支。
目前，公眾持有的債務已超過 31.3 兆美元，CBO 預測這比例將從目前的 GDP 101% 上升至 2036 年的 120%，打破二戰後的紀錄。

貝森特的「自衛」策略

在美債危機深化的背景下，財政部長貝森特展開了一場看似「拯救他人貨幣」的行動。7 月底，日元一度跌至 1986 年以來的最低水準。隨後，美日展開了十多年來首次的協同干預。在一次大衛營的內閣會議上，貝森特的筆記本被拍到寫著一項代辦事項：「買入日元 (JPY)50-100 億美元」。

paras: 2026年08月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國鋰電電解銅箔製造商龍電華鑫（Londian Wason New Energy Tech）啟動美國首次公開募股（IPO），公司估值最高可達17億美元，若順利完成，可望成為2026年中國企業在紐約規模最大的上市案。
近一年來，美中關係緊張，加上中國加強企業赴海外上市審查，中國企業赴美IPO案例明顯減少，因此龍電華鑫此次上市，也被視為觀察國際投資人對中國企業投資意願的重要指標。
根據招股書，龍電華鑫預計發行約360萬股美國存託憑證（ADS），每股發行價格介於20至22美元，預計募資最高7,860萬美元；若承銷商全數行使超額配售權，募資金額最高可達9,040萬。

公司股東包括南韓SK Group及未來資產（Mirae Asset）。此外，Harvest Global Capital Investments、Hithium Global及其他投資人已表達認購意願，分別計畫認購5000萬、700萬及3000萬的存託憑證，已獲部分機構投資人支持。

paras_en: On August 3, 2026, Londian Wason New Energy Tech, a Chinese manufacturer of lithium electrolytic copper foil, initiated its US initial public offering (IPO), with an estimated valuation of up to $1.7 billion. If successful, it is expected to become the largest Chinese IPO in the US in 2026.

Over the past year, the number of Chinese companies listing in the US has decreased significantly due to tense US-China relations and China's tightened oversight of companies listing overseas. As a result, Londian Wason New Energy Tech's IPO is seen as an important indicator of international investors' willingness to invest in Chinese companies.

According to the prospectus, Londian Wason New Energy Tech plans to issue approximately 3.6 million American Depositary Shares (ADS), with an offering price between $20 and $22 per share, aiming to raise up to $78.6 million. If the underwriters exercise their over-allotment option in full, the total proceeds could reach $90.4 million.

Londian Wason New Energy Tech primarily produces lithium electrolytic copper foil, a crucial material for lithium battery negative current collectors and an essential component for manufacturing power and energy storage batteries. The company is positioned in the midstream of the battery supply chain, purchasing additives and other raw materials from chemical material suppliers, producing electrolytic copper foil, and then supplying it to battery manufacturers for use in electric vehicles, energy storage systems, and consumer electronics.

In 2025, the company's lithium copper foil shipment volume was approximately 111,985 tons, with a designed production capacity of around 180,500 tons, making it one of the largest electrolytic copper foil manufacturers globally in terms of planned production capacity.

On the downstream customer side, Londian Wason New Energy Tech has entered the global major battery supply chain, with clients including LG Energy Solution, Panasonic Industrial Materials, SK On, Samsung SDI, ATL, CATL, BYD, and Xinwangda, among other global battery manufacturers. Notably, the company has been a key copper foil supplier to LG Energy Solution since 2015 and has supplied Panasonic Industrial Materials with PCB-use copper foil for 12 years, demonstrating deep customer relationships.

The company's shareholders include South Korea's SK Group and Mirae Asset. Additionally, Harvest Global Capital Investments, Hithium Global, and other investors have expressed their intention to subscribe, planning to purchase 50 million, 7 million, and 30 million ADS, respectively, with support from some institutional investors.

In terms of finance, as of March 31, 2026, the first quarter of the 2026 fiscal year, Londian Wason New Energy Tech's revenue was 4.07 billion yuan, higher than the 1.91 billion yuan in the same period last year. The company's net profit was 135 million yuan, turning a profit from a loss of 68.4 million yuan in the same period last year, reflecting significant improvement in operating performance due to the rebound in demand for electrolytic copper foil.

This IPO is jointly underwritten by Cantor, Huatai Securities, CM Securities, Tiger Securities, Fortune Securities, and VC Brokerage. Londian Wason New Energy Tech plans to list on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the ticker symbol 'FOIL'.

paras: 台北股匯今 (3) 日表現不同調，大盤持續反彈逾 260 點，新台幣兌美元匯率先升後貶，外資轉向匯出，匯價單日高低價差高達近 3 角，但央行強力穩匯，帶動貶幅收斂，終場收在 32.438 元，重貶 1.46 角，台北與元太外匯總成交值爆出 39.2 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天以 32.26 元開盤後，一度升抵 32.21 元、升值 8.2 分，但外資與進口商聯手買匯，使得匯價應聲翻黑，接連失守 32.3、32.4 元兩道關卡，最低下探 32.49 元、重貶近 2 角，與強勢日元走勢明顯脫鉤。
考量短線貶勢過於猛烈，且與整體亞洲貨幣走勢脫鉤，央行隨即擴大防守力道，力保 32.5 元整數關卡不失。在尾盤調節下，貶幅逐步收斂，終場收在 32.438 元，單日貶值 1.46 角。
美伊談判樂觀情緒升溫，原油重挫逾 4%，美元指數應聲跌破 100 大關，加上美日聯手干預匯市，推升日元單日飆升 2.18%，韓元同步升值 0.16%；人民幣小貶 0.08%，新台幣重貶 0.45%，成本日最弱亞幣。
